```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Master Interface
// - 内置 write / read task，均以 DW(4byte) 为最小粒度
// - awsize/arsize 固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
// - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 上限拆分成多个 burst
// - id 内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos 固定为0
// - write 的 strb 为单个4bit值，仅在单DW写时生效，多DW写强制全1
// - read 的返回数据保存在内部成员 rd_data 中，不作为task输出参数
// - 所有AXI信号驱动均为非阻塞赋值+TP延迟，模拟clk-to-out时序
// ================================================================
interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,   // 单次burst最大拍数，AXI4协议上限为256
    parameter TP         = 0.1      // 非阻塞赋值延迟（clk-to-out时序），单位时间步
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    // -------- 标准AXI4时钟复位命名（等于传入的clk/rst_n） --------
    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此内部成员，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;   // 每拍能装几个DW
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);      // 总线全宽对应的size

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效（对该DW做部分字节写/零写）
    //           data.size()>1 时该参数被忽略，所有拍强制全字节使能(4'b1111)
    // - id内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos固定为0
    // - awsize固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
    // - 自动按MAX_BEATS拆分成多个burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb = 4'b1111
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;
        bit single_dw;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AW channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            awid    <= #TP cur_id;
            awaddr  <= #TP (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            awlen   <= #TP (beat_cnt - 1);
            awsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
            awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- W channel ----
            begin
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                for (int b = 0; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                    end

                    wdata  <= #TP beat_data;
                    wstrb  <= #TP beat_strb;
                    wlast  <= #TP (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    wvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!wready);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
            end
            wvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- B channel ----
            bready <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!bvalid);
            bready <= #TP 1'b0;

            if (bresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, bid, bresp, cur_addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE OK: id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                           $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr    : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw: 需要读取的DW个数，默认1（单DW读）
    // - 返回数据不通过output参数传出，而是保存在内部成员 rd_data 中，
    //   调用方读完后可直接访问 axi_if.rd_data[i]
    // - id内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos固定为0
    // - arsize固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
    // - 自动按MAX_BEATS拆分成多个burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw = 1
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AR channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            arid    <= #TP cur_id;
            araddr  <= #TP (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            arlen   <= #TP (beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!arready);
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- R channel ----
            rready <= #TP 1'b1;
            begin
                int b = 0;
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                while (b < beat_cnt) begin
                    @(posedge aclk);
                    if (rvalid && rready) begin
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            rd_data[idx + dw_ptr + l] = rdata[lane*32 +: 32];
                        end

                        if (rresp != 2'b00)
                            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h beat=%0d",
                                      $time, rid, rresp, cur_addr, b);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                        b++;
                    end
                end
            end
            rready <= #TP 1'b0;

            $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE(sub-burst): id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                       $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ ALL DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d", $time, addr, total_dw);
    endtask

endinterface


// ================================================================
// AXI4 Slave Interface (with internal memory model)
// - 对 Master 的读写请求做出响应
// - 内部有 1MB 内存空间，地址范围 [0, MEM_SIZE)
// - 支持 burst 传输，按 DATA_WIDTH 对齐地址
// - 固定返回 OKAY (bresp/rresp = 0)
// - 所有输出均为非阻塞赋值+TP延迟
// ================================================================
interface axi4_slave_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter TP         = 0.1
) (
    input logic aclk,
    input logic aresetn
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;
    localparam MEM_SIZE   = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB

    // -------- Memory model --------
    logic [7:0] mem [0:MEM_SIZE-1];

    // -------- 写地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- 初始化内存 --------
    initial begin
        for (int i = 0; i < MEM_SIZE; i++)
            mem[i] = 8'h00;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Address Channel (AW) - 接受 AW 地址
    // ============================================================
    always_comb begin
        awready = 1'b1; // 总是可以接受
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Data Channel (W) - 接收写数据
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            awlen_q;
    logic [2:0]            awsize_q;
    logic [1:0]            awburst_q;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            wready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            awid_q   <= #TP '0;
            awaddr_q <= #TP '0;
            awlen_q  <= #TP '0;
            awsize_q <= #TP '0;
            awburst_q<= #TP '0;
        end else begin
            // 捕获 AW 通道信息
            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                awid_q    <= #TP awid;
                awaddr_q  <= #TP awaddr;
                awlen_q   <= #TP awlen;
                awsize_q  <= #TP awsize;
                awburst_q <= #TP awburst;
            end

            // W 通道 ready: 在收到 aw 之后开始准备接收数据
            if (awvalid && awready)
                wready <= #TP 1'b1;
            else if (wvalid && wready && wlast)
                wready <= #TP 1'b0;
        end
    end

    // -------- 写数据存储 --------
    logic [7:0] beat_cnt_w;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            beat_cnt_w <= #TP '0;
            bid        <= #TP '0;
            bresp      <= #TP '0;
            bvalid     <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (wvalid && wready) begin
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr = awaddr_q;
                // 计算当前 beat 的地址偏移
                automatic int beat_offset = beat_cnt_w * STRB_WIDTH;
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = base_addr + beat_offset;

                // 按字节写入 memory
                for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
                    if (wstrb[b] && (cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                        mem[cur_addr + b] <= #TP wdata[b*8 +: 8];
                    end
                end

                if (wlast) begin
                    // 发送 B 响应
                    bid    <= #TP awid_q;
                    bresp  <= #TP 2'b00; // OKAY
                    bvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    beat_cnt_w <= #TP '0;
                end else begin
                    beat_cnt_w <= #TP beat_cnt_w + 1;
                end
            end

            // 等待 master 接收 B 响应
            if (bvalid && bready) begin
                bvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Address Channel (AR) - 接受 AR 地址
    // ============================================================
    always_comb begin
        arready = 1'b1; // 总是可以接受
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Data Channel (R) - 发送读数据
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            arlen_q;
    logic [2:0]            arsize_q;
    logic [1:0]            arburst_q;
    logic                  ar_done;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            arid_q    <= #TP '0;
            araddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            arlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            arsize_q  <= #TP '0;
            arburst_q <= #TP '0;
            ar_done   <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (arvalid && arready) begin
                arid_q    <= #TP arid;
                araddr_q  <= #TP araddr;
                arlen_q   <= #TP arlen;
                arsize_q  <= #TP arsize;
                arburst_q <= #TP arburst;
                ar_done   <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            rid    <= #TP '0;
            rdata  <= #TP '0;
            rresp  <= #TP 2'b00;
            rlast  <= #TP 1'b0;
            rvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // 有 AR 请求且尚未完成时，开始发送 R 数据
            if (arvalid && arready) begin
                rvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            end else if (rvalid && rready) begin
                // 读完一拍数据，准备下一拍或结束
                if (rlast) begin
                    rvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    rvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                end
            end

            if (rvalid && rready) begin
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr;
                automatic int beat_offset;
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr;
                automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_beat_data;

                base_addr   = araddr_q;
                beat_offset = 0;
                // 如果之前发过数据，计算当前 beat 偏移
                // 这里简化处理：用内部计数器跟踪
                cur_addr = base_addr + beat_offset;

                rd_beat_data = '0;
                for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
                    if ((cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                        rd_beat_data[b*8 +: 8] = mem[cur_addr + b];

                rdata <= #TP rd_beat_data;
                rresp <= #TP 2'b00;
                rlast <= #TP (beat_offset / STRB_WIDTH == arlen_q);
            end
        end
    end

endinterface
```

```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Master Interface
// - 内置 write / read task，均以 DW(4byte) 为最小粒度
// - awsize/arsize 固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
// - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 上限拆分成多个 burst
// - id 内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos 固定为0
// - write 的 strb 为单个4bit值，仅在单DW写时生效，多DW写强制全1
// - read 的返回数据保存在内部成员 rd_data 中，不作为task输出参数
// - 所有AXI信号驱动均为非阻塞赋值+TP延迟，模拟clk-to-out时序
// ================================================================
interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,   // 单次burst最大拍数，AXI4协议上限为256
    parameter TP         = 0.1      // 非阻塞赋值延迟（clk-to-out时序），单位时间步
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    // -------- 标准AXI4时钟复位命名（等于传入的clk/rst_n） --------
    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此内部成员，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;   // 每拍能装几个DW
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);      // 总线全宽对应的size

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效（对该DW做部分字节写/零写）
    //           data.size()>1 时该参数被忽略，所有拍强制全字节使能(4'b1111)
    // - id内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos固定为0
    // - awsize固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
    // - 自动按MAX_BEATS拆分成多个burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb = 4'b1111
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;
        bit single_dw;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AW channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            awid    <= #TP cur_id;
            awaddr  <= #TP (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            awlen   <= #TP (beat_cnt - 1);
            awsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
            awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- W channel ----
            begin
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                for (int b = 0; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                    end

                    wdata  <= #TP beat_data;
                    wstrb  <= #TP beat_strb;
                    wlast  <= #TP (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    wvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!wready);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
            end
            wvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- B channel ----
            bready <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!bvalid);
            bready <= #TP 1'b0;

            if (bresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, bid, bresp, cur_addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE OK: id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                           $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr    : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw: 需要读取的DW个数，默认1（单DW读）
    // - 返回数据不通过output参数传出，而是保存在内部成员 rd_data 中，
    //   调用方读完后可直接访问 axi_if.rd_data[i]
    // - id内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos固定为0
    // - arsize固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
    // - 自动按MAX_BEATS拆分成多个burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw = 1
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AR channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            arid    <= #TP cur_id;
            araddr  <= #TP (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            arlen   <= #TP (beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!arready);
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- R channel ----
            rready <= #TP 1'b1;
            begin
                int b = 0;
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                while (b < beat_cnt) begin
                    @(posedge aclk);
                    if (rvalid && rready) begin
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            rd_data[idx + dw_ptr + l] = rdata[lane*32 +: 32];
                        end

                        if (rresp != 2'b00)
                            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h beat=%0d",
                                      $time, rid, rresp, cur_addr, b);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                        b++;
                    end
                end
            end
            rready <= #TP 1'b0;

            $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE(sub-burst): id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                       $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ ALL DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d", $time, addr, total_dw);
    endtask

endinterface


// ================================================================
// AXI4 Slave Interface (with internal memory model)
// - 对 Master 的读写请求做出响应
// - 内部有 1MB 内存空间，地址范围 [0, MEM_SIZE)
// - 支持 burst 传输，按 DATA_WIDTH 对齐地址
// - 固定返回 OKAY (bresp/rresp = 0)
// - 所有输出均为非阻塞赋值+TP延迟
// ================================================================
interface axi4_slave_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter TP         = 0.1
) (
    input logic aclk,
    input logic aresetn
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;
    localparam MEM_SIZE   = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB

    // -------- Memory model --------
    logic [7:0] mem [0:MEM_SIZE-1];

    // -------- 写地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- 初始化内存 --------
    initial begin
        for (int i = 0; i < MEM_SIZE; i++)
            mem[i] = 8'h00;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Address Channel (AW) - 接受 AW 地址
    // ============================================================
    always_comb begin
        awready = 1'b1; // 总是可以接受
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Data Channel (W) - 接收写数据
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            awlen_q;
    logic [2:0]            awsize_q;
    logic [1:0]            awburst_q;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            wready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            awid_q   <= #TP '0;
            awaddr_q <= #TP '0;
            awlen_q  <= #TP '0;
            awsize_q <= #TP '0;
            awburst_q<= #TP '0;
        end else begin
            // 捕获 AW 通道信息
            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                awid_q    <= #TP awid;
                awaddr_q  <= #TP awaddr;
                awlen_q   <= #TP awlen;
                awsize_q  <= #TP awsize;
                awburst_q <= #TP awburst;
            end

            // W 通道 ready: 在收到 aw 之后开始准备接收数据
            if (awvalid && awready)
                wready <= #TP 1'b1;
            else if (wvalid && wready && wlast)
                wready <= #TP 1'b0;
        end
    end

    // -------- 写数据存储 --------
    logic [7:0] beat_cnt_w;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            beat_cnt_w <= #TP '0;
            bid        <= #TP '0;
            bresp      <= #TP '0;
            bvalid     <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (wvalid && wready) begin
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr = awaddr_q;
                // 计算当前 beat 的地址偏移
                automatic int beat_offset = beat_cnt_w * STRB_WIDTH;
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = base_addr + beat_offset;

                // 按字节写入 memory
                for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
                    if (wstrb[b] && (cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                        mem[cur_addr + b] <= #TP wdata[b*8 +: 8];
                    end
                end

                if (wlast) begin
                    // 发送 B 响应
                    bid    <= #TP awid_q;
                    bresp  <= #TP 2'b00; // OKAY
                    bvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    beat_cnt_w <= #TP '0;
                end else begin
                    beat_cnt_w <= #TP beat_cnt_w + 1;
                end
            end

            // 等待 master 接收 B 响应
            if (bvalid && bready) begin
                bvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Address Channel (AR) - 接受 AR 地址
    // ============================================================
    always_comb begin
        arready = 1'b1; // 总是可以接受
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Data Channel (R) - 发送读数据
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            arlen_q;
    logic [2:0]            arsize_q;
    logic [1:0]            arburst_q;
    logic                  ar_done;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            arid_q    <= #TP '0;
            araddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            arlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            arsize_q  <= #TP '0;
            arburst_q <= #TP '0;
            ar_done   <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (arvalid && arready) begin
                arid_q    <= #TP arid;
                araddr_q  <= #TP araddr;
                arlen_q   <= #TP arlen;
                arsize_q  <= #TP arsize;
                arburst_q <= #TP arburst;
                ar_done   <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            rid    <= #TP '0;
            rdata  <= #TP '0;
            rresp  <= #TP 2'b00;
            rlast  <= #TP 1'b0;
            rvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // 有 AR 请求且尚未完成时，开始发送 R 数据
            if (arvalid && arready) begin
                rvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            end else if (rvalid && rready) begin
                // 读完一拍数据，准备下一拍或结束
                if (rlast) begin
                    rvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    rvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                end
            end

            if (rvalid && rready) begin
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr;
                automatic int beat_offset;
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr;
                automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_beat_data;

                base_addr   = araddr_q;
                beat_offset = 0;
                // 如果之前发过数据，计算当前 beat 偏移
                // 这里简化处理：用内部计数器跟踪
                cur_addr = base_addr + beat_offset;

                rd_beat_data = '0;
                for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
                    if ((cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                        rd_beat_data[b*8 +: 8] = mem[cur_addr + b];
                    end
                end

                rid   <= #TP arid_q;
                rdata <= #TP rd_beat_data;
                rresp <= #TP 2'b00;
                rlast <= #TP (beat_offset / STRB_WIDTH == arlen_q);
            end
        end
    end

endinterface
```

```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Slave Interface (with internal memory model)
// - 对 Master 的读写请求做出响应
// - 内部有 1MB 内存空间，地址范围 [0, MEM_SIZE)
// - 支持 burst 传输，地址按 STRB_WIDTH 对齐递增
// - 固定返回 OKAY (bresp/rresp = 0)
// - 所有输出均为非阻塞赋值+TP延迟
// ================================================================
interface axi4_slave_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter TP         = 0.1
) (
    input logic aclk,
    input logic aresetn
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;
    localparam MEM_SIZE   = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB

    // -------- Memory model --------
    logic [7:0] mem [0:MEM_SIZE-1];

    // -------- 写地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- 初始化内存 --------
    initial begin
        for (int i = 0; i < MEM_SIZE; i++)
            mem[i] = 8'h00;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Channels (AW + W + B)
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            awlen_q;
    logic [7:0]            wbeat_cnt;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            awready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            wready    <= #TP 1'b0;
            awid_q    <= #TP '0;
            awaddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            awlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            wbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            bid       <= #TP '0;
            bresp     <= #TP 2'b00;
            bvalid    <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // ---- AW: 可以接受地址（无背压） ----
            awready <= #TP 1'b1;

            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                awid_q   <= #TP awid;
                awaddr_q <= #TP awaddr;
                awlen_q  <= #TP awlen;
            end

            // ---- W: 接收到 AW 后打开 wready ----
            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                wready    <= #TP 1'b1;
                wbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            end

            if (wvalid && wready) begin
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = awaddr_q + wbeat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;

                // 按字节写入 memory（考虑 wstrb）
                for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
                    if (wstrb[b] && (cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                        mem[cur_addr + b] <= #TP wdata[b*8 +: 8];
                    end
                end

                if (wlast) begin
                    wready <= #TP 1'b0; // 关闭 wready，等待下次 AW
                    // 发送 B 响应
                    bid    <= #TP awid_q;
                    bresp  <= #TP 2'b00; // OKAY
                    bvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    wbeat_cnt <= #TP wbeat_cnt + 1;
                end
            end

            // ---- B: master 接收响应后撤销 ----
            if (bvalid && bready) begin
                bvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Channels (AR + R)
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            arlen_q;
    logic [7:0]            rbeat_cnt;
    logic                  r_active;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            arready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            arid_q    <= #TP '0;
            araddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            arlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            rbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            r_active  <= #TP 1'b0;
            rid       <= #TP '0;
            rdata     <= #TP '0;
            rresp     <= #TP 2'b00;
            rlast     <= #TP 1'b0;
            rvalid    <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // ---- AR: 可以接受地址（无背压） ----
            arready <= #TP 1'b1;

            if (arvalid && arready && !r_active) begin
                arid_q   <= #TP arid;
                araddr_q <= #TP araddr;
                arlen_q  <= #TP arlen;
                rbeat_cnt<= #TP '0;
                r_active <= #TP 1'b1;
                // 立即发送第一拍数据
                rvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                {rdata, rlast, rid, rresp} <= #TP get_rbeat(araddr, arid, arlen, 0);
            end else if (rvalid && rready) begin
                if (rlast) begin
                    // burst 结束
                    rvalid   <= #TP 1'b0;
                    r_active <= #TP 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    automatic logic [7:0] next_beat = rbeat_cnt + 1;
                    rbeat_cnt <= #TP next_beat;
                    rvalid    <= #TP 1'b1;
                    {rdata, rlast, rid, rresp} <= #TP get_rbeat(araddr_q, arid_q, arlen_q, next_beat);
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // -------- 辅助函数：生成 R beat 数据 --------
    function automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH+ID_WIDTH+3:0] get_rbeat(
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr,
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   id,
        logic [7:0]            len,
        logic [7:0]            beat
    );
        automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = base_addr + beat * STRB_WIDTH;
        automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data = '0;

        for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
            if ((cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                rd_data[b*8 +: 8] = mem[cur_addr + b];
            end
        end

        return {rd_data, (beat == len), id, 2'b00};
    endfunction

endinterface
```

```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Slave Interface (with internal memory model)
// - 对 Master 的读写请求做出响应
// - 内部有 1MB 内存空间，地址范围 [0, MEM_SIZE)

interface axi4_slave_if #(

) (

);

    localparam MEM_SIZE   = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB

    logic [7:0] mem [0:MEM_SIZE-1];

    // -------- 写地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;

    logic [1:0]            awburst;

    // -------- 写数据通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- 初始化内存 --------
    initial begin
        for (int i = 0; i < MEM_SIZE; i++)
            mem[i] = 8'h00;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Address Channel (AW) - 接受 AW 地址
    // ============================================================
    always_comb begin
        awready = 1'b1; // 总是可以接受
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Data Channel (W) - 接收写数据
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            awlen_q;
    logic [2:0]            awsize_q;
    logic [1:0]            awburst_q;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            wready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            awid_q   <= #TP '0;
            awaddr_q <= #TP '0;
            awlen_q  <= #TP '0;
            awsize_q <= #TP '0;
            awburst_q<= #TP '0;
        end else begin
            // 捕获 AW 通道信息
            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                awid_q    <= #TP awid;
                awaddr_q  <= #TP awaddr;
                awlen_q   <= #TP awlen;
                awsize_q  <= #TP awsize;
                awburst_q <= #TP awburst;
            end

            // W 通道 ready: 在收到 aw 之后开始准备接收数据
            if (awvalid && awready)
                wready <= #TP 1'b1;
            else if (wvalid && wready && wlast)
                wready <= #TP 1'b0;
        end
    end

    // -------- 写数据存储 --------
    logic [7:0] beat_cnt_w;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin

            bvalid     <= #TP 1'b0;

                    bid    <= #TP awid_q;

                    bvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    beat_cnt_w <= #TP '0;
                end else begin
                    beat_cnt_w <= #TP beat_cnt_w + 1;
                end
            end

            // 等待 master 接收 B 响应
            if (bvalid && bready) begin
                bvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Address Channel (AR) - 接受 AR 地址
    // ============================================================
    always_comb begin
        arready = 1'b1; // 总是可以接受
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Data Channel (R) - 发送读数据
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            arlen_q;
    logic [2:0]            arsize_q;
    logic [1:0]            arburst_q;
    logic                  ar_done;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            arid_q    <= #TP '0;
            araddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            arlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            arsize_q  <= #TP '0;
            arburst_q <= #TP '0;
            ar_done   <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (arvalid && arready) begin
                arid_q    <= #TP arid;

                arlen_q   <= #TP arlen;
                arsize_q  <= #TP arsize;
                arburst_q <= #TP arburst;

            end

        if (!aresetn) begin
            rid    <= #TP '0;
            rdata  <= #TP '0;
            rresp  <= #TP 2'b00;

                rresp <= #TP 2'b00;
                rlast <= #TP (beat_offset / STRB_WIDTH == arlen_q);

        end
    end
```

```
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- 初始化内存 --------
    initial begin
        for (int i = 0; i < MEM_SIZE; i++)
            mem[i] = 8'h00;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Channels (AW + W + B)
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            awlen_q;
    logic [7:0]            wbeat_cnt;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            awready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            wready    <= #TP 1'b0;
            awid_q    <= #TP '0;
            awaddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            awlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            wbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            bid       <= #TP '0;
            bresp     <= #TP 2'b00;
            bvalid    <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // ---- AW: 可以接受地址（无背压） ----
            awready <= #TP 1'b1;

            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                awid_q   <= #TP awid;
                awaddr_q <= #TP awaddr;
                awlen_q  <= #TP awlen;
            end

            // ---- W: 接收到 AW 后打开 wready ----
            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                wready    <= #TP 1'b1;
                wbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            end

            if (wvalid && wready) begin
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = awaddr_q + wbeat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;

                // 按字节写入 memory（考虑 wstrb）
                for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
                    if (wstrb[b] && (cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                        mem[cur_addr + b] <= #TP wdata[b*8 +: 8];
                    end
                end

                if (wlast) begin
                    wready <= #TP 1'b0; // 关闭 wready，等待下次 AW
                    // 发送 B 响应
                    bid    <= #TP awid_q;
                    bresp  <= #TP 2'b00; // OKAY
                    bvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    wbeat_cnt <= #TP wbeat_cnt + 1;
                end
            end

            // ---- B: master 接收响应后撤销 ----
            if (bvalid && bready) begin
                bvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Channels (AR + R)
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            arlen_q;
    logic [7:0]            rbeat_cnt;
    logic                  r_active;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            arready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            arid_q    <= #TP '0;
            araddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            arlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            rbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            r_active  <= #TP 1'b0;
            rid       <= #TP '0;
            rdata     <= #TP '0;
            rresp     <= #TP 2'b00;
            rlast     <= #TP 1'b0;
            rvalid    <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // ---- AR: 可以接受地址（无背压） ----
            arready <= #TP 1'b1;

            if (arvalid && arready && !r_active) begin
                arid_q   <= #TP arid;
                araddr_q <= #TP araddr;
                arlen_q  <= #TP arlen;
                rbeat_cnt<= #TP '0;
                r_active <= #TP 1'b1;
                // 立即发送第一拍数据
                rvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                {rdata, rlast, rid, rresp} <= #TP get_rbeat(araddr, arid, arlen, 0);
            end else if (rvalid && rready) begin
                if (rlast) begin
                    // burst 结束
                    rvalid   <= #TP 1'b0;
                    r_active <= #TP 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    automatic logic [7:0] next_beat = rbeat_cnt + 1;
                    rbeat_cnt <= #TP next_beat;
                    rvalid    <= #TP 1'b1;
                    {rdata, rlast, rid, rresp} <= #TP get_rbeat(araddr_q, arid_q, arlen_q, next_beat);
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // -------- 辅助函数：生成 R beat 数据 --------
    function automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH+ID_WIDTH+3:0] get_rbeat(
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr,
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   id,
        logic [7:0]            len,
        logic [7:0]            beat
    );
        automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = base_addr + beat * STRB_WIDTH;
        automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data = '0;

        for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
            if ((cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                rd_data[b*8 +: 8] = mem[cur_addr + b];
            end
        end

        return {rd_data, (beat == len), id, 2'b00};
    endfunction
```

文件已创建完成。`axi4_if.sv` 包含两个接口：

**1. `axi4_if` — AXI4 Master Interface**
- 与 `amba_if.sv` 中的 master 一致，带 `write/read` task
- 支持参数化 `ADDR_WIDTH`、`DATA_WIDTH`、`ID_WIDTH`、`MAX_BEATS`、`TP`
- DW（4字节）为最小粒度，自动拆 burst、地址对齐

**2. `axi4_slave_if` — AXI4 Slave Interface**（新增）
- 内置 1MB 内存模型
- 响应 master 的 AW/W/B 和 AR/R 通道请求
- 支持 burst 传输，按 `STRB_WIDTH` 地址对齐递增
- 固定返回 `OKAY` 响应
- 带 `aresetn` 异步复位，所有输出使用 `#TP` 延迟

使用时直接例化即可：
```systemverilog
axi4_if #(.ADDR_WIDTH(32), .DATA_WIDTH(128)) master (.*);
axi4_slave_if #(.ADDR_WIDTH(32), .DATA_WIDTH(128)) slave (.*);
```

```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Interface
// - 仅定义 AXI4 全部通道信号、clocking block、modport
// - 不包含任何 task 实现
// ================================================================

interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4
) (
    input logic aclk,
    input logic aresetn
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // ============================================================
    // Clocking Blocks
    // ============================================================

    // Master 域：在 aclk 上升沿采样/驱动
    clocking cb_master @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #0;
        // AW
        output awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        output awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        output awvalid;
        input  awready;
        // W
        output wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        input  wready;
        // B
        input  bid, bresp, bvalid;
        output bready;
        // AR
        output arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        output arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        output arvalid;
        input  arready;
        // R
        input  rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        output rready;
    endclocking

    // Slave 域：在 aclk 上升沿采样/驱动
    clocking cb_slave @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #0;
        // AW
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        input  awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        input  awvalid;
        output awready;
        // W
        input  wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        output wready;
        // B
        output bid, bresp, bvalid;
        input  bready;
        // AR
        input  arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        input  arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        input  arvalid;
        output arready;
        // R
        output rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        input  rready;
    endclocking

    // ============================================================
    // Modports
    // ============================================================

    // Master 侧：使用 cb_master，驱动给 slave 的信号
    modport master (
        clocking cb_master,
        // 异步信号（aresetn 直接用全局的）
        // 所有通道信号通过 clocking 驱动/采样
    );

    // Slave 侧：使用 cb_slave，响应 master 请求
    modport slave (
        clocking cb_slave
    );

    // 直连（无 clocking），用于 monitor / passive 观察
    modport monitor (
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
               awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos,
               awvalid, awready,
               wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid, wready,
               bid, bresp, bvalid, bready,
               arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst,
               arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos,
               arvalid, arready,
               rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid, rready
    );

endinterface
```

```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Master Interface
// - 内置 write / read task，均以 DW(4byte) 为最小粒度
// - awsize/arsize 固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
// - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 上限拆分成多个 burst
// - id 内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos 固定为0
// - write 的 strb 为单个4bit值，仅在单DW写时生效，多DW写强制全1
// - read 的返回数据保存在内部成员 rd_data 中，不作为task输出参数
// - 所有AXI信号驱动均为非阻塞赋值+TP延迟，模拟clk-to-out时序
// ================================================================
interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,   // 单次burst最大拍数，AXI4协议上限为256
    parameter TP         = 0.1      // 非阻塞赋值延迟（clk-to-out时序），单位时间步
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    // -------- 标准AXI4时钟复位命名（等于传入的clk/rst_n） --------
    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此内部成员，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;   // 每拍能装几个DW
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);      // 总线全宽对应的size

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效（对该DW做部分字节写/零写）
    //           data.size()>1 时该参数被忽略，所有拍强制全字节使能(4'b1111)
    // - id内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos固定为0
    // - awsize固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
    // - 自动按MAX_BEATS拆分成多个burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb = 4'b1111
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;
        bit single_dw;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AW channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            awid    <= #TP cur_id;
            awaddr  <= #TP (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            awlen   <= #TP (beat_cnt - 1);
            awsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
            awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- W channel ----
            begin
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                for (int b = 0; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                    end

                    wdata  <= #TP beat_data;
                    wstrb  <= #TP beat_strb;
                    wlast  <= #TP (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    wvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!wready);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
            end
            wvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- B channel ----
            bready <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!bvalid);
            bready <= #TP 1'b0;

            if (bresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, bid, bresp, cur_addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE OK: id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                           $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr    : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw: 需要读取的DW个数，默认1（单DW读）
    // - 返回数据不通过output参数传出，而是保存在内部成员 rd_data 中，
    //   调用方读完后可直接访问 axi_if.rd_data[i]
    // - id内部随机生成；lock/cache/prot/qos固定为0
    // - arsize固定为总线全宽，地址按STRB_WIDTH对齐递增
    // - 自动按MAX_BEATS拆分成多个burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw = 1
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AR channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            arid    <= #TP cur_id;
            araddr  <= #TP (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            arlen   <= #TP (beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!arready);
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

            // ---- R channel ----
            rready <= #TP 1'b1;
            begin
                int b = 0;
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                while (b < beat_cnt) begin
                    @(posedge aclk);
                    if (rvalid && rready) begin
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            rd_data[idx + dw_ptr + l] = rdata[lane*32 +: 32];
                        end

                        if (rresp != 2'b00)
                            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h beat=%0d",
                                      $time, rid, rresp, cur_addr, b);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                        b++;
                    end
                end
            end
            rready <= #TP 1'b0;

            $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE(sub-burst): id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                       $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ ALL DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d", $time, addr, total_dw);
    endtask

endinterface


// ================================================================
// AXI4 Slave Interface (with internal memory model)
// - 对 Master 的读写请求做出响应
// - 内部有 1MB 内存空间，地址范围 [0, MEM_SIZE)
// - 支持 burst 传输，地址按 STRB_WIDTH 对齐递增
// - 固定返回 OKAY (bresp/rresp = 0)
// - 所有输出均为非阻塞赋值+TP延迟
// ================================================================
interface axi4_slave_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter TP         = 0.1
) (
    input logic aclk,
    input logic aresetn
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;
    localparam MEM_SIZE   = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB

    // -------- Memory model --------
    logic [7:0] mem [0:MEM_SIZE-1];

    // -------- 写地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 (input from master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 (output to master) --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // -------- 初始化内存 --------
    initial begin
        for (int i = 0; i < MEM_SIZE; i++)
            mem[i] = 8'h00;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Write Channels (AW + W + B)
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            awlen_q;
    logic [7:0]            wbeat_cnt;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            awready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            wready    <= #TP 1'b0;
            awid_q    <= #TP '0;
            awaddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            awlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            wbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            bid       <= #TP '0;
            bresp     <= #TP 2'b00;
            bvalid    <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // ---- AW: 可以接受地址（无背压） ----
            awready <= #TP 1'b1;

            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                awid_q   <= #TP awid;
                awaddr_q <= #TP awaddr;
                awlen_q  <= #TP awlen;
            end

            // ---- W: 接收到 AW 后打开 wready ----
            if (awvalid && awready) begin
                wready    <= #TP 1'b1;
                wbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            end

            if (wvalid && wready) begin
                automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = awaddr_q + wbeat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;

                // 按字节写入 memory（考虑 wstrb）
                for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
                    if (wstrb[b] && (cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                        mem[cur_addr + b] <= #TP wdata[b*8 +: 8];
                    end
                end

                if (wlast) begin
                    wready <= #TP 1'b0; // 关闭 wready，等待下次 AW
                    // 发送 B 响应
                    bid    <= #TP awid_q;
                    bresp  <= #TP 2'b00; // OKAY
                    bvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    wbeat_cnt <= #TP wbeat_cnt + 1;
                end
            end

            // ---- B: master 接收响应后撤销 ----
            if (bvalid && bready) begin
                bvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // Read Channels (AR + R)
    // ============================================================
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid_q;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr_q;
    logic [7:0]            arlen_q;
    logic [7:0]            rbeat_cnt;
    logic                  r_active;

    always_ff @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            arready   <= #TP 1'b0;
            arid_q    <= #TP '0;
            araddr_q  <= #TP '0;
            arlen_q   <= #TP '0;
            rbeat_cnt <= #TP '0;
            r_active  <= #TP 1'b0;
            rid       <= #TP '0;
            rdata     <= #TP '0;
            rresp     <= #TP 2'b00;
            rlast     <= #TP 1'b0;
            rvalid    <= #TP 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // ---- AR: 可以接受地址（无背压） ----
            arready <= #TP 1'b1;

            if (arvalid && arready && !r_active) begin
                arid_q   <= #TP arid;
                araddr_q <= #TP araddr;
                arlen_q  <= #TP arlen;
                rbeat_cnt<= #TP '0;
                r_active <= #TP 1'b1;
                // 立即发送第一拍数据
                rvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                {rdata, rlast, rid, rresp} <= #TP get_rbeat(araddr, arid, arlen, 0);
            end else if (rvalid && rready) begin
                if (rlast) begin
                    // burst 结束
                    rvalid   <= #TP 1'b0;
                    r_active <= #TP 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    automatic logic [7:0] next_beat = rbeat_cnt + 1;
                    rbeat_cnt <= #TP next_beat;
                    rvalid    <= #TP 1'b1;
                    {rdata, rlast, rid, rresp} <= #TP get_rbeat(araddr_q, arid_q, arlen_q, next_beat);
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // -------- 辅助函数：生成 R beat 数据 --------
    function automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH+ID_WIDTH+3:0] get_rbeat(
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] base_addr,
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   id,
        logic [7:0]            len,
        logic [7:0]            beat
    );
        automatic logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = base_addr + beat * STRB_WIDTH;
        automatic logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data = '0;

        for (int b = 0; b < STRB_WIDTH; b++) begin
            if ((cur_addr + b) < MEM_SIZE) begin
                rd_data[b*8 +: 8] = mem[cur_addr + b];
            end
        end

        return {rd_data, (beat == len), id, 2'b00};
    endfunction

endinterface
```
