```
Interface
// - 仅定义 AXI4 全部通道信号、clocking block、modport
// - 不包含任何 task 实现
// ================================================================

interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4
) (
    input logic aclk,
    input logic aresetn
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // ============================================================
    // Clocking Blocks
    // ============================================================

    // Master 域：在 aclk 上升沿驱动/采样
    clocking cb_master @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #0;
        // AW
        output awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        output awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        output awvalid;
        input  awready;
        // W
        output wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        input  wready;
        // B
        input  bid, bresp, bvalid;
        output bready;
        // AR
        output arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        output arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        output arvalid;
        input  arready;
        // R
        input  rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        output rready;
    endclocking

    // Slave 域：在 aclk 上升沿驱动/采样
    clocking cb_slave @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #0;
        // AW
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        input  awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        input  awvalid;
        output awready;
        // W
        input  wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        output wready;
        // B
        output bid, bresp, bvalid;
        input  bready;
        // AR
        input  arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        input  arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        input  arvalid;
        output arready;
        // R
        output rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        input  rready;
    endclocking

    // ============================================================
    // Modports
    // ============================================================

    // Master 侧
    modport master (
        clocking cb_master
    );

    // Slave 侧
    modport slave (
        clocking cb_slave
    );

    // 无 clocking 的直连观察口
    modport monitor (
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
               awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos,
               awvalid, awready,
               wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid, wready,
               bid, bresp, bvalid, bready,
               arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst,
               arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos,
               arvalid, arready,
               rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid, rready
    );
```

```
interface axi4_if #(
```

_**User (2026-07-21 05:26:42Z)**_

clocking block有什么用

---

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

**Clocking block** 是 SystemVerilog 中用于 **同步 testbench 信号驱动与采样** 的构造，主要用途：

1. **统一时序控制** — 定义信号在时钟沿的 **驱动偏移**（`output #xxx`）和 **采样时机**（`input #xxx`），避免 testbench 中到处写 `@(posedge clk)` 和 `#delay`

2. **消除竞争** — 默认 `input #1step` 在时钟沿前的"一步"采样，`output #0` 在时钟沿后零延迟驱动，确保 DUT 与 testbench 不会在同一个时间步相互抢占

3. **与 modport 配合** — 将 clocking 放入 modport，让 master/slave 的时序一目了然

```systemverilog
// 典型用法
clocking cb @(posedge clk);
    default input #1step output #0;
    output awvalid, awaddr;
    input  awready;
endclocking

// 驱动（自动在时钟沿后输出）
cb.awvalid <= 1'b1;
cb.awaddr  <= addr;

// 采样（自动在时钟沿前采样）
wait (cb.awready);
```

不过你的接口是纯信号定义（给 RTL 和 TB 共用），clocking 属于 **TB 侧专用** 的语法，通常不放接口里，而是放在 TB 的 program 或 class 中。所以之前去掉是对的。

---

_**User (2026-07-21 05:27:57Z)**_

如果在接口里定义了clocking，我用task驱动这个接口，还需要加延迟吗？

---

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

如果在 task 中**通过 clocking block 驱动信号**，则**不需要**加额外延迟，clocking 已经替你处理了时序。

对比一下：

### 不用 clocking（你原来的写法）
```systemverilog
task write(...);
    @(posedge aclk);
    awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;   // 手动加 TP 延迟
    awaddr  <= #TP addr;
    do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
    awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
endtask
```

### 用 clocking
```systemverilog
clocking cb @(posedge aclk);
    default input #1step output #0;
    output awvalid, awaddr;
    input  awready;
endclocking

task write(...);
    // clocking 自动在时钟沿后驱动
    cb.awvalid <= 1'b1;
    cb.awaddr  <= addr;
    // clocking 在时钟沿前采样 awready，无需手动 wait
    @(posedge aclk);  // 等待一拍让 slave 响应
    while (!cb.awready) @(posedge aclk);
    cb.awvalid <= 1'b0;
endtask
```

clocking 的 **`output #0`** 保证信号在时钟沿之后才更新，**`input #1step`** 保证在时钟沿之前采样输入，天然消除了竞争，`#TP` 这种手动延迟就不需要了。

不过注意：如果既用 clocking 又同时直接赋值给原始信号（如 `awvalid <= ...`），clocking 的时序控制就不生效了，需要二选一。

```
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // ============================================================
    // Clocking Blocks
    // - output #TP 模拟 clk-to-out 延迟
    // - input #1step 在时钟沿前采样，避免竞争
    // ============================================================

    clocking cb_master @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #TP;
        // AW
        output awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        output awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        output awvalid;
        input  awready;
        // W
        output wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        input  wready;
        // B
        input  bid, bresp, bvalid;
        output bready;
        // AR
        output arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        output arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        output arvalid;
        input  arready;
        // R
        input  rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        output rready;
    endclocking

    clocking cb_slave @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #TP;
        // AW
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        input  awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        input  awvalid;
        output awready;
        // W
        input  wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        output wready;
        // B
        output bid, bresp, bvalid;
        input  bready;
        // AR
        input  arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        input  arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        input  arvalid;
        output arready;
        // R
        output rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        input  rready;
    endclocking

    // ============================================================
    // Modports
    // ============================================================

    modport master (clocking cb_master);
    modport slave  (clocking cb_slave);

    modport monitor (
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
               awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos,
               awvalid, awready,
               wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid, wready,
               bid, bresp, bvalid, bready,
               arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst,
               arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos,
               arvalid, arready,
               rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid, rready
    )
```
</details></tool-use>

已加上 `TP` 参数（默认 0.1），clocking 的 output 延迟使用 `#TP`。task 中通过 clocking 驱动时无需再加额外延迟：

```systemverilog
// 例化时自定义 TP
axi4_if #(.TP(0.2)) bus (.*);

// task 中直接驱动，clocking 自动加 #TP 延迟
task automatic write(...);
    cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
    cb_master.awaddr  <= addr;
    @(posedge aclk);
    while (!cb_master.awready) @(posedge aclk);
    cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b0;
endtask
```

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

可以实例化，但当前接口的 modport 基于 clocking block，**只能用于 testbench**，不能直接用于 RTL 模块连接（clocking 不可综合）。

具体情况如下：

### 1. TB task ↔ DUT 模块 ✅
```
task → cb_master → 信号 → DUT(monitor modport)
```
TB 的 task 通过 `cb_master` 驱动，DUT 用 `monitor` modport 直连信号，完全可行。

### 2. RTL 模块 ↔ RTL 模块 ❌ 当前不行
当前 `master`/`slave` modport 引用 clocking，不可综合。

需要加 **RTL 专用 modport**（不含 clocking），像这样：

```systemverilog
modport rtl_master (
    output awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
           awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos, awvalid,
    input  awready,
    output wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid,
    input  wready,
    input  bid, bresp, bvalid,
    output bready,
    output arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst,
           arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos, arvalid,
    input  arready,
    input  rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid,
    output rready
);

modport rtl_slave (
    input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
           awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos, awvalid,
    output awready,
    input  wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid,
    output wready,
    output bid, bresp, bvalid,
    input  bready,
    input  arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst,
           arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos, arvalid,
    output arready,
    output rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid,
    input  rready
);
```

然后例化：
```systemverilog
// RTL 连接
axi4_if bus (.*);
axi_master u_mst (.axi(bus.rtl_master));
axi_slave  u_slv (.axi(bus.rtl_slave));

// TB 中 task 通过 clocking 驱动
task automatic write(input ...);
    bus.cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
    ...
endtask
```

那直接用 clocking modport 就行，两个仿真模块各连各的 clocking：

```systemverilog
axi4_if bus (.*);

master_bfm u_mst (.axi(bus.master));   // 内部用 bus.cb_master.xxx <= ...

// TB 中的 slave BFM → 用 cb_slave 驱动

```

两边都通过 clocking 驱动，`output #TP` 自动模拟 clk-to-out 延迟，`input #1step` 在时钟沿前采样，天然无竞争，不需要再加 modport 了。

_**User (2026-07-21 05:31:09Z)**_

bfm是什么意思

---

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

**BFM** = **Bus Functional Model**（总线功能模型）

它是验证环境中用来 **驱动或响应总线协议** 的组件，本质上是一个封装了总线协议操作的模块/类。

### 典型 BFM 做的事：
- 按协议时序驱动信号（如 AXI 的 AW → W → B 握手流程）
- 封装成高层 task，让测试用例只需调用 `write(addr, data)`、`read(addr)` 等
- 不关心具体实现逻辑，只关心总线协议层面的行为

### 示例：
```systemverilog
class axi4_master_bfm;
    virtual axi4_if.master vif;

    task write(addr, data);
        vif.cb_master.awaddr <= addr;
        vif.cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
        @(posedge vif.aclk);
        while (!vif.cb_master.awready) @(posedge vif.aclk);
        vif.cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b0;
        vif.cb_master.wdata <= data;
        vif.cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
        // ...
    endtask
endclass
```

把 BFM 插在测试用例和接口之间，测试代码就不用直接跟信号波形打交道了。

_**User (2026-07-21 05:32:02Z)**_

`#1step`是什么意思

---

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

`#1step` 是 clocking block 中 **input 采样的默认延迟值**，表示在**时钟沿发生前的一个精度步长**采样。

具体来说：

| 延迟 | 含义 |
|------|------|
| `input #1step` | 在时钟沿之前 **一个时间精度步长（time precision step）** 采样输入信号 |
| `output #TP` | 在时钟沿之后 **TP 时间** 驱动输出信号 |

### 为什么用 `#1step`？

假设时间精度是 1ps，`#1step` 就是 **1ps**。这样 clocking 的采样时机是：

```
                 采  时钟沿  驱
                 样    ↑    动
                 ←1ps→|←TP→
```

- **采样**（input）：在时钟沿前 1ps 读到信号的稳定值
- **驱动**（output）：在时钟沿后 TP 才更新信号

这就避免了 **testbench 和 DUT 在同一个时间步互相抢占** 的竞争问题。如果不用 `#1step`，可能在时钟沿时刻 DUT 正更新输出、TB 正采样输入，谁先谁后不确定，导致仿真结果随机。

```
// ================================================================
// APB4 Interface
// - 信号声明 + clocking block（带可配置 TP 延迟）
// ================================================================

interface apb_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter TP         = 0.1   // clocking output 延迟
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    // -------- 内部时钟/复位 --------
    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    // -------- APB4 信号 --------
    logic                  psel;
    logic                  penable;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] paddr;
    logic                  pwrite;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] pwdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] pstrb;      // APB4 写选通
    logic [2:0]            pprot;       // APB4 保护信号
    logic                  pready;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] prdata;
    logic                  pslverr;

    // ============================================================
    // Clocking Blocks
    // ============================================================

    clocking cb_master @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #TP;
        output psel, penable, paddr, pwrite, pwdata, pstrb, pprot;
        input  pready, prdata, pslverr;
    endclocking

    clocking cb_slave @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #TP;
        input  psel, penable, paddr, pwrite, pwdata, pstrb, pprot;
        output pready, prdata, pslverr;
    endclocking

    // ============================================================
    // Modports
    // ============================================================

    modport master (clocking cb_master);
    modport slave  (clocking cb_slave);

    modport monitor (
        input psel, penable, paddr, pwrite, pwdata, pstrb, pprot,
              pready, prdata, pslverr
    );

endinterface

```

```
    // ============================================================
```
```
    // APB_RD_WR TASK (Read-Modify-Write)
    // - 先读 addr 当前值，将 data 中 mask=1 的位替换写入，mask=0 的位保持
    // - 组合公式: wr_data = (rd_data & ~mask) | (data & mask)
    // - 旧值通过 rd_data 输出（可选）
    // ============================================================
    task automatic apb_rd_wr(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]       addr,
        input  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]       data,
        input  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]       mask,
        output [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]       rd_data
    );
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data;

        // ---- Read phase ----
        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.psel    <= 1'b1;
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.paddr   <= addr;
        cb_master.pwrite  <= 1'b0;

        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b1;

        while (!cb_master.pready) @(posedge pclk);

        rd_data = cb_master.prdata;

        if (cb_master.pslverr)
            $display("[%0t] APB RD_WR SLVERR on read: addr=0x%0h", $time, addr);

        // ---- Modify ----
        wr_data = (rd_data & ~mask) | (data & mask);

        // ---- Write phase ----
        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.paddr   <= addr;
        cb_master.pwrite  <= 1'b1;
        cb_master.pwdata  <= wr_data;
        // psel 一直保持 1，不需要重新拉高
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;  // 回到 SETUP

        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b1;

        while (!cb_master.pready) @(posedge pclk);

        if (cb_master.pslverr)
            $display("[%0t] APB RD_WR SLVERR on write: addr=0x%0h", $time, addr);
        else
            $display("[%0t] APB RD_WR DONE: addr=0x%0h rd=0x%0h wr=0x%0h mask=0x%0h",
                       $time, addr, rd_data, wr_data, mask);

        cb_master.psel    <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
    endtask
```

```
    // ============================================================
```
```
    // APB_RD_WR TASK (Read-Modify-Write)
    // - 先读 addr 当前值，修改 [msb:lsb] 位为 data 中对应位，其余位不变
    // - msb == lsb 时仅修改 1bit
    // - 组合: wr_data[msb:lsb] = data[msb:lsb], 其余保持
    // ============================================================
    task automatic apb_rd_wr(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data,
        input  int              msb,
        input  int              lsb
    );
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data;
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mask;
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data;

        // ---- 生成掩码 ----
        mask = '0;
        for (int i = lsb; i <= msb; i++) mask[i] = 1'b1;

        // ---- Read phase ----
        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.psel    <= 1'b1;
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.paddr   <= addr;
        cb_master.pwrite  <= 1'b0;

        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b1;

        while (!cb_master.pready) @(posedge pclk);

        rd_data = cb_master.prdata;

        if (cb_master.pslverr)
            $display("[%0t] APB RD_WR SLVERR on read: addr=0x%0h", $time, addr);

        // ---- Modify ----
        wr_data = (rd_data & ~mask) | (data & mask);

        // ---- Write phase ----
        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.paddr   <= addr;
        cb_master.pwrite  <= 1'b1;
        cb_master.pwdata  <= wr_data;
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;  // 回到 SETUP

        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b1;

        while (!cb_master.pready) @(posedge pclk);

        if (cb_master.pslverr)
            $display("[%0t] APB RD_WR SLVERR on write: addr=0x%0h", $time, addr);
        else
            $display("[%0t] APB RD_WR DONE: addr=0x%0h data=0x%0h range[%0d:%0d]",
                       $time, addr, wr_data, msb, lsb);

        cb_master.psel    <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
    endtask
```

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

该有的都有了，目前已经比较完整。唯一可以考虑补充的是 **pready 超时保护**——如果 slave 一直不拉 pready，仿真会卡死：

```systemverilog
task automatic write(...);
    int timeout = 1000;
    @(posedge pclk);
    cb_master.psel    <= 1'b1;
    cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
    cb_master.paddr   <= addr;
    cb_master.pwrite  <= 1'b1;
    cb_master.pwdata  <= data;

    @(posedge pclk);
    cb_master.penable <= 1'b1;

    while (!cb_master.pready && timeout > 0) begin
        @(posedge pclk);
        timeout--;
    end
    if (timeout == 0) $fatal(1, "APB WRITE timeout: addr=0x%0h", addr);
    // ...
endtask
```

不过如果 TB 的 slave 模型是可靠的，这个也不是必须的。你觉得需要加超时保护吗？

只作为 master 用的话没有多驱问题。`cb_master` 只驱动 **psel/penable/paddr/pwrite/pwdata**，这些在 master 场景下本来就是唯一的驱动源。而 **pready/prdata/pslverr** 是输入，由 DUT/slave 驱动。

```
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
```

```
        $display("[%0t] APB WRITE DONE: addr=0x%0h data=0x%0h", $time, addr, data);
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - APB 读传输：SETUP → ACCESS → IDLE（不等待 pready，固定 2 周期）
    // - 返回数据通过 output 参数 rd_data 传出
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        output [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data
    );
        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.psel    <= 1'b1;
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.paddr   <= addr;
        cb_master.pwrite  <= 1'b0;

        @(posedge pclk);
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b1;

        @(posedge pclk);  // ACCESS 完成
        rd_data = cb_master.prdata;

        if (cb_master.pslverr)
            $display("[%0t] APB READ SLVERR: addr=0x%0h", $time, addr);
        else
            $display("[%0t] APB READ DONE: addr=0x%0h data=0x%0h", $time, addr, rd_data);

        cb_master.psel    <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.penable <= 1'b0;
    endtask
```

```
    // ============================================================
    // Clocking Block (Master)
    // - output #TP 模拟 clk-to-out 延迟
    // - input #1step 在时钟沿前采样，避免竞争
    // ============================================================

    clocking cb_master @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #TP;
        // AW
        output awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        output awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        output awvalid;
        input  awready;
        // W
        output wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        input  wready;
        // B
        input  bid, bresp, bvalid;
        output bready;
        // AR
        output arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        output arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        output arvalid;
        input  arready;
        // R
        input  rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        output rready;
    endclocking

    // ============================================================
    // Modports
    // ============================================================

    modport master (clocking cb_master);

    modport monitor (
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
               awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos,
               awvalid, awready,
               wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid, wready,

               arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos,
               arvalid, arready,
               rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid, rready
    );

endinterface
```

```
    modport master (clocking cb_master);

    modport monitor (
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
```

```
    );

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 拆分成多个 burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb = 4'b1111
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;
        bit single_dw;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AW channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.awid    <= cur_id;
            cb_master.awaddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.awlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
            cb_master.awsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.awburst <= 2'b01;
            cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.awready);
            cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b0;

            // ---- W channel ----
            begin
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                for (int b = 0; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                    end

                    cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
                    cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
                    cb_master.wlast  <= (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
            end
            cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b0;

            // ---- B channel ----
            cb_master.bready <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);
            cb_master.bready <= 1'b0;

            if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h",
                           $time, cb_master.bid, cb_master.bresp, cur_addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE OK: id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                           $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr    : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw: 需要读取的DW个数，默认1
    // - 结果保存在内部成员 rd_data[] 中
    // - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 拆分成多个 burst
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw = 1
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] cur_id;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            cur_id = $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);

            // ---- AR channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.arid    <= cur_id;
            cb_master.araddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.arlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
            cb_master.arsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.arburst <= 2'b01;
            cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.arcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.arready);
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b0;

            // ---- R channel ----
            cb_master.rready <= 1'b1;
            begin
                int b = 0;
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                while (b < beat_cnt) begin
                    @(posedge aclk);
                    if (cb_master.rvalid && cb_master.rready) begin
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            rd_data[idx + dw_ptr + l] = cb_master.rdata[lane*32 +: 32];
                        end

                        if (cb_master.rresp != 2'b00)
                            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h beat=%0d",
                                      $time, cb_master.rid, cb_master.rresp, cur_addr, b);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                        b++;
                    end
                end
            end
            cb_master.rready <= 1'b0;

            $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE(sub-burst): id=%0d addr=0x%0h beats=%0d dw=%0d",
                       $time, cur_id, cur_addr, beat_cnt, dw_covered);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ ALL DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d", $time, addr, total_dw);
    endtask

endinterface
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="replace_string_in_file"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **replace_string_in_file**</summary>

**Input:**

- filePath: `c:\Users\man\Desktop\code\axi4_if.sv`
- newString:

```
    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK（流水线模式）
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 拆分成多个 burst
    // - AW/W 连续发送，不等 B 响应；所有 B 在最后统一收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb = 4'b1111
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        bit single_dw;
        int burst_cnt = 0;
        int b_ok_cnt = 0;
        int b_err_cnt = 0;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        // ---- 第一阶段：发送所有 AW/W（流水线，不等 B） ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            burst_cnt++;

            // ---- AW channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.awid    <= $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);
            cb_master.awaddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.awlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
            cb_master.awsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.awburst <= 2'b01;
            cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.awready);

            // ---- W channel ----
            begin
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                for (int b = 0; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                    end

                    cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
                    cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
                    cb_master.wlast  <= (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
            end
            cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b0;

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二阶段：统一收集所有 B 响应 ----
        for (int i = 0; i < burst_cnt; i++) begin
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);
            if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00) begin
                b_err_cnt++;
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.bid, cb_master.bresp);
            end else begin
                b_ok_cnt++;
            end
        end

        if (b_err_cnt > 0)
            $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: %0d OK, %0d ERR", $time, b_ok_cnt, b_err_cnt);
        else
            $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ALL DONE: %0d bursts OK", $time, burst_cnt);
    endtask
```

```
        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        // ---- 第一阶段：发送所有 AW/W（流水线，不等 B） ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
            int beat_cnt;
            int dw_covered;

            if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end else begin
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            burst_cnt++;

            // ---- AW channel ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.awid    <= $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);
            cb_master.awaddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.awlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
            cb_master.awsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.awburst <= 2'b01;
            cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.awready);

            // ---- W channel ----
            begin
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                for (int b = 0; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                    end

                    cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
                    cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
                    cb_master.wlast  <= (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
            end
            cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b0;

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二阶段：统一收集所有 B 响应 ----
        for (int i = 0; i < burst_cnt; i++) begin
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);
            if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00) begin
                b_err_cnt++;
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.bid, cb_master.bresp);
            end else begin
                b_ok_cnt++;
            end
        end

        if (b_err_cnt > 0)
            $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: %0d OK, %0d ERR", $time, b_ok_cnt, b_err_cnt);
        else
            $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ALL DONE: %0d bursts OK", $time, burst_cnt);
```

```
            cb_master.araddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.arlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
            cb_master.arsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.arburst <= 2'b01;
            cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.arcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.arready);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二阶段：统一收集所有 R 数据 ----
        cb_master.rready <= 1'b1;
        for (int b = 0; b < burst_cnt; b++) begin
            int base    = burst_start[b];
            int b_dw    = burst_dw[b];
            int l_off   = burst_lane[b];
            int dw_ptr  = 0;
            int beat    = 0;
            int beat_cnt_b = (b_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1 - l_off) / DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (beat_cnt_b <= 0) beat_cnt_b = 1;
            else begin
                int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - l_off;
                if (b_dw <= first_beat_dw) beat_cnt_b = 1;
                else begin
                    int rest = b_dw - first_beat_dw;
                    beat_cnt_b = 1 + (rest + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                end
            end

            while (beat < beat_cnt_b) begin
                @(posedge aclk);
                if (cb_master.rvalid) begin
                    int lane_start = (beat == 0) ? l_off : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > b_dw)
                        lanes_this_beat = b_dw - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        rd_data[base + dw_ptr + l] = cb_master.rdata[lane*32 +: 32];
                    end

                    if (cb_master.rresp != 2'b00)
                        $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.rid, cb_master.rresp);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                    beat++;
                end
            end
        end
        cb_master.rready <= 1'b0;
```

```
    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 拆分成多个 burst
    // - 单DW时 burst=1，等待B后再返回；多DW时流水线模式
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb = 4'b1111
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        bit single_dw;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        if (single_dw) begin
            // ======== 单 DW：顺序 AW→W→B ========
            logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
            logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;

            for (int l = 0; l < DW_PER_BEAT; l++) begin
                beat_data[l*32 +: 32] = data[0];
                beat_strb[l*4  +: 4]  = strb;
            end

            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.awid    <= $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);
            cb_master.awaddr  <= cur_addr;
            cb_master.awlen   <= 8'b0;
            cb_master.awsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.awburst <= 2'b01;
            cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.awready);

            cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
            cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
            cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b1;
            cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);
            cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b0;

            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);
            if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, cb_master.bresp, addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE OK: addr=0x%0h data=0x%0h", $time, addr, data[0]);

        end else begin
            // ======== 多 DW：流水线模式（AW/W连续，B统一收集） ========
            int idx = 0;
            int burst_cnt = 0;
            int b_ok_cnt = 0;
            int b_err_cnt = 0;

            while (idx < total_dw) begin
                int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
                int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
                int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
                int beat_cnt;
                int dw_covered;

                if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                    beat_cnt   = 1;
                    dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end else begin
                    int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                    int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                    beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                    dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end

                burst_cnt++;

                @(posedge aclk);
                cb_master.awid    <= $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);
                cb_master.awaddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
                cb_master.awlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
                cb_master.awsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
                cb_master.awburst <= 2'b01;
                cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
                cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
                cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
                do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.awready);

                begin
                    int dw_ptr = 0;
                    for (int b = 0; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                        logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                            beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                            beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = 4'b1111;
                        end

                        cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
                        cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
                        cb_master.wlast  <= (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                        cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
                        do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                    end
                end
                cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b0;

                idx      += dw_covered;
                cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
            end

            for (int i = 0; i < burst_cnt; i++) begin
                do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);
                if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00) begin
                    b_err_cnt++;
                    $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.bid, cb_master.bresp);
                end else begin
                    b_ok_cnt++;
                end
            end

            if (b_err_cnt > 0)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: %0d OK, %0d ERR", $time, b_ok_cnt, b_err_cnt);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ALL DONE: %0d bursts OK", $time, burst_cnt);
        end
    endtask
```

```
    task automatic write(

                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                    end

                    cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
                    cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
                    cb_master.wlast  <= (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
            end
            cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b0;

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二阶段：统一收集所有 B 响应 ----
        for (int i = 0; i < burst_cnt; i++) begin
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);
            if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00) begin
                b_err_cnt++;
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.bid, cb_master.bresp);
            end else begin
                b_ok_cnt++;
            end
        end

        if (b_err_cnt > 0)
            $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: %0d OK, %0d ERR", $time, b_ok_cnt, b_err_cnt);
        else
            $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ALL DONE: %0d bursts OK", $time, burst_cnt);
    endtask
```

```
    );
```

```
    task automatic read(

        while (idx < total_dw) begin

            int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
            int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;

                beat_cnt   = 1;
                dw_covered = dw_remain;
```

```
                int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
            end

            burst_start[burst_cnt] = idx;
            burst_beats[burst_cnt] = beat_cnt;
            burst_dw[burst_cnt]    = dw_covered;
            burst_lane[burst_cnt]  = lane_offset;
            burst_cnt++;

            // ---- AR channel（连续请求：arvalid 保持高） ----
            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.arid    <= $urandom_range(0, (1 << ID_WIDTH) - 1);
            cb_master.araddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.arlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
            cb_master.arsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.arburst <= 2'b01;
            cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;

            cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.arready);

            idx      += dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二阶段：统一收集所有 R 数据 ----
        cb_master.rready <= 1'b1;
        for (int b = 0; b < burst_cnt; b++) begin

            int b_beats = burst_beats[b];
            int b_dw    = burst_dw[b];
            int l_off   = burst_lane[b];
            int dw_ptr  = 0;
            int beat    = 0;

            while (beat < b_beats) begin
                @(posedge aclk);
                if (cb_master.rvalid) begin
                    int lane_start = (beat == 0) ? l_off : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > b_dw)
                        lanes_this_beat = b_dw - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        rd_data[base + dw_ptr + l] = cb_master.rdata[(lane_start + l)*32 +: 32];
                    end

                    if (cb_master.rresp != 2'b00)
                        $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.rid, cb_master.rresp);

                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                    beat++;
                end
            end
        end
        cb_master.rready <= 1'b0;

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ ALL DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d", $time, addr, total_dw);
    endtask
```

你学习下11是怎么实现的

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

已学习完。这个版本的核心思路：

### 架构特点

| 特性 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **mailbox 收响应** | 后台 `initial` 常驻监听 B/R 通道，数据推入 mailbox，不阻塞主线程 |
| **fork-join 并行** | AW 和 W 分别独立线程推进，互不阻塞 |
| **分步计算+驱动** | 先纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数，再统一驱动信号 |
| **无 clocking** | 直接用 `#TP` 非阻塞赋值，不用 clocking block/modport |

### 写流程
1. 算出全部 sub-burst 参数（不消耗仿真时间）
2. `fork`：AW 线程 + W 线程 **并行** 推进，各自只受自己的 ready 反压
3. `join` 后按 FIFO 顺序从 mailbox 收 B

### 读流程
1. 算出全部 sub-burst 参数
2. AR 背靠背连续发（valid 不掉）
3. 从 mailbox 按 FIFO 收 R 数据，解包到 `rd_data[]`

### 和当前 `axi4_if.sv` 的主要差异

- **响应收集**：11 用 mailbox + 后台进程，我们用同步等待
- **AW/W 并行**：11 用 fork-join 实现真正独立推进，我们顺序发送
- **字节上限**：11 有 `max_burst_bytes` 参数，我们没有
- **驱动方式**：11 直接用信号 + `#TP`，我们用 clocking block
- **ID 匹配**：两者都不做 ID 匹配，假设 FIFO 顺序返回

要我基于这种架构重写 `axi4_if.sv` 吗？

_**Agent (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="create_file"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **create_file**</summary>

Created `axi4_if.sv`

**Input:**

- content:

```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Master Interface
// - AW/W 通过 fork-join 并行独立推进，互不阻塞
// - B/R 响应通过 mailbox + 后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集
// - 自动按 MAX_BEATS / max_burst_bytes 拆分成 sub-burst
// - awid/arid 自增累加，仅用于协议/调试，不用于响应匹配
// - 不支持乱序响应，假设 DUT 按 FIFO 顺序返回
// ================================================================
interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,   // 单次burst最大拍数
    parameter TP         = 0.1    // clk-to-out 延迟
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // mailbox：后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集 B/R 响应
    // ============================================================
    mailbox #(bit [1:0]) b_mbox = new();

    typedef struct {
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data;
        bit [1:0]              resp;
    } r_beat_t;
    mailbox #(r_beat_t) r_mbox = new();

    // -------- awid/arid 自增计数器 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] awid_ctr;
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] arid_ctr;

    initial begin
        awid_ctr = '0;
        arid_ctr = '0;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 B channel（bready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        bready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (bvalid === 1'b1)
                b_mbox.put(bresp);
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 R channel（rready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        rready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (rvalid === 1'b1) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                beat.data = rdata;
                beat.resp = rresp;
                r_mbox.put(beat);
            end
        end
    end

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    // ============================================================
    // sub-burst 参数描述
    // ============================================================
    typedef struct {
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr;
        int                    beat_cnt;
        int                    dw_covered;
        int                    lane_offset;
        int                    idx;
    } sub_burst_t;

    // ============================================================
    // 计算单个 sub-burst 参数
    // ============================================================
    function automatic sub_burst_t calc_sub_burst(
        input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr,
        input int                    idx,
        input int                    dw_remain,
        input int                    max_dw_cap
    );
        int lane_offset, first_beat_dw, beat_cnt, dw_covered;

        lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
        first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;

        if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
            beat_cnt   = 1;
            dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end else begin
            int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
            int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
            beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
            dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end

        if (dw_covered > max_dw_cap) begin
            dw_covered = max_dw_cap;
            if (dw_covered <= first_beat_dw)
                beat_cnt = 1;
            else
                beat_cnt = 1 + (dw_covered - first_beat_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
        end

        calc_sub_burst.addr        = cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES);
        calc_sub_burst.beat_cnt    = beat_cnt;
        calc_sub_burst.dw_covered  = dw_covered;
        calc_sub_burst.lane_offset = lane_offset;
        calc_sub_burst.idx         = idx;
    endfunction

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大写入字节数，默认128
    // - AW/W 通过 fork-join 并行推进，互不阻塞
    // - 所有 B 响应通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb            = 4'b1111,
        input int              max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        bit single_dw;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数（不占用仿真时间） ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AW/W 作为两个独立线程并行推进 ----
        fork
            // AW 线程
            begin
                @(posedge aclk);
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    awid    <= #TP awid_ctr;
                    awid_ctr = awid_ctr + 1'b1;
                    awaddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
                    awlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                    awsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
                    awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
                    awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
                    awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
                    awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
                end
                awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
            // W 线程
            begin
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    int dw_ptr = 0;
                    for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                        logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            int gidx = sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l;
                            logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                            beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                            beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                        end

                        wdata  <= #TP beat_data;
                        wstrb  <= #TP beat_strb;
                        wlast  <= #TP (b == sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                        wvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                        do @(posedge aclk); while (!wready);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                    end
                end
                wvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
                wlast  <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        join

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 B 响应 ----
        for (int k = 0; k < sub_list.size(); k++) begin
            bit [1:0] resp;
            b_mbox.get(resp);
            if (resp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: sub-burst#%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, k, resp, addr);
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr           : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw       : 需要读取的DW个数，默认1
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大读取字节数，默认128
    // - AR 背靠背连续发送所有 sub-burst
    // - 所有 R 数据通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw        = 1,
        input  int               max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AR 背靠背连续发送，valid 全程不掉 ----
        @(posedge aclk);
        for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
            arid    <= #TP arid_ctr;
            arid_ctr = arid_ctr + 1'b1;
            araddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
            arlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!arready);
        end
        arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 R 数据并解包 ----
        foreach (sub_list[s]) begin
            int dw_ptr = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                int lane_start, lanes_this_beat;

                r_mbox.get(beat);

                lane_start      = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                    lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                    int lane = lane_start + l;
                    rd_data[sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l] = beat.data[lane*32 +: 32];
                }

                if (beat.resp != 2'b00)
                    $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: sub-burst#%0d beat#%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h",
                               $time, s, b, beat.resp, addr);

                dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
            end
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
    endtask

endinterface
```
