// ================================================================
// AXI4 Master Interface
// - AW/W 通过 fork-join 并行独立推进，互不阻塞
// - B/R 响应通过 mailbox + 后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集
// - 自动按 MAX_BEATS / max_burst_bytes 拆分成 sub-burst
// - awid/arid 自增累加，仅用于协议/调试，不用于响应匹配
// - 不支持乱序响应，假设 DUT 按 FIFO 顺序返回
// ================================================================
interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,   // 单次burst最大拍数
    parameter TP         = 0.1    // clk-to-out 延迟
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // mailbox：后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集 B/R 响应
    // ============================================================
    mailbox #(bit [1:0]) b_mbox = new();

    typedef struct {
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data;
        bit [1:0]              resp;
    } r_beat_t;
    mailbox #(r_beat_t) r_mbox = new();

    // -------- awid/arid 自增计数器 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] awid_ctr;
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] arid_ctr;

    initial begin
        awid_ctr = '0;
        arid_ctr = '0;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 B channel（bready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        bready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (bvalid === 1'b1)
                b_mbox.put(bresp);
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 R channel（rready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        rready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (rvalid === 1'b1) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                beat.data = rdata;
                beat.resp = rresp;
                r_mbox.put(beat);
            end
        end
    end

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    // ============================================================
    // sub-burst 参数描述
    // ============================================================
    typedef struct {
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr;
        int                    beat_cnt;
        int                    dw_covered;
        int                    lane_offset;
        int                    idx;
    } sub_burst_t;

    // ============================================================
    // 计算单个 sub-burst 参数
    // ============================================================
    function automatic sub_burst_t calc_sub_burst(
        input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr,
        input int                    idx,
        input int                    dw_remain,
        input int                    max_dw_cap
    );
        int lane_offset, first_beat_dw, beat_cnt, dw_covered;

        lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
        first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;

        if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
            beat_cnt   = 1;
            dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end else begin
            int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
            int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
            beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
            dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end

        if (dw_covered > max_dw_cap) begin
            dw_covered = max_dw_cap;
            if (dw_covered <= first_beat_dw)
                beat_cnt = 1;
            else
                beat_cnt = 1 + (dw_covered - first_beat_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
        end

        calc_sub_burst.addr        = cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES);
        calc_sub_burst.beat_cnt    = beat_cnt;
        calc_sub_burst.dw_covered  = dw_covered;
        calc_sub_burst.lane_offset = lane_offset;
        calc_sub_burst.idx         = idx;
    endfunction

    // ============================================================
    // INIT TASK：初始化输出信号
    // ============================================================
    task automatic init();
        awid    <= #TP '0;
        awaddr  <= #TP '0;
        awlen   <= #TP '0;
        awsize  <= #TP '0;
        awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
        awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
        awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
        awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
        awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
        awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        wdata   <= #TP '0;
        wstrb   <= #TP '0;
        wlast   <= #TP 1'b0;
        wvalid  <= #TP 1'b0;
        bready  <= #TP 1'b1;
        arid    <= #TP '0;
        araddr  <= #TP '0;
        arlen   <= #TP '0;
        arsize  <= #TP '0;
        arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
        arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
        arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
        arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
        arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
        arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        rready  <= #TP 1'b0;
        awid_ctr = '0;
        arid_ctr = '0;
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大写入字节数，默认128
    // - AW/W 通过 fork-join 并行推进，互不阻塞
    // - 所有 B 响应通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb            = 4'b1111,
        input int              max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        bit single_dw;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AW/W 作为两个独立线程并行推进 ----
        fork
            // AW 线程
            begin
                @(posedge aclk);
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    awid    <= #TP awid_ctr;
                    awid_ctr = awid_ctr + 1'b1;
                    awaddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
                    awlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                    awsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
                    awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
                    awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
                    awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
                    awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
                end
                awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
            // W 线程
            begin
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    int dw_ptr = 0;
                    for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                        logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            int gidx = sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l;
                            logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                            beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                            beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                        end

                        wdata  <= #TP beat_data;
                        wstrb  <= #TP beat_strb;
                        wlast  <= #TP (b == sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                        wvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                        do @(posedge aclk); while (!wready);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                    end
                end
                wvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
                wlast  <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        join

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 B 响应 ----
        for (int k = 0; k < sub_list.size(); k++) begin
            bit [1:0] resp;
            b_mbox.get(resp);
            if (resp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: sub-burst#%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, k, resp, addr);
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr           : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw       : 需要读取的DW个数，默认1
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大读取字节数，默认128
    // - AR 背靠背连续发送所有 sub-burst
    // - 所有 R 数据通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw        = 1,
        input  int               max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AR 背靠背连续发送，valid 全程不掉 ----
        @(posedge aclk);
        for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
            arid    <= #TP arid_ctr;
            arid_ctr = arid_ctr + 1'b1;
            araddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
            arlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!arready);
        end
        arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 R 数据并解包 ----
        foreach (sub_list[s]) begin
            int dw_ptr = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                int lane_start, lanes_this_beat;

                r_mbox.get(beat);

                lane_start      = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                    lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                    int lane = lane_start + l;
                    rd_data[sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l] = beat.data[lane*32 +: 32];
                }

                if (beat.resp != 2'b00)
                    $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: sub-burst#%0d beat#%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h",
                               $time, s, b, beat.resp, addr);

                dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
            end
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
    endtask

endinterface

// ================================================================
// AXI4 Interface
// - 信号声明 + clocking block（带可配置 TP 延迟）
// - 不含 task，由外部 TB 通过 clocking 驱动
// ================================================================

interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 64,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,  // 单次burst最大拍数，AXI4协议上限为256
    parameter TP         = 0.1   // clocking output 延迟，模拟 clk-to-out
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    // -------- 内部时钟/复位（等于传入的 clk/rst_n） --------
    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    // ============================================================
    // Clocking Block (Master)
    // - output #TP 模拟 clk-to-out 延迟
    // - input #1step 在时钟沿前采样，避免竞争
    // ============================================================

    clocking cb_master @(posedge aclk);
        default input #1step output #TP;
        // AW
        output awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst;
        output awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos;
        output awvalid;
        input  awready;
        // W
        output wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid;
        input  wready;
        // B
        input  bid, bresp, bvalid;
        output bready;
        // AR
        output arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst;
        output arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos;
        output arvalid;
        input  arready;
        // R
        input  rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid;
        output rready;
    endclocking

    // ============================================================
    // Modports
    // ============================================================

    modport master (clocking cb_master);

    modport monitor (
        input  awid, awaddr, awlen, awsize, awburst,
               awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos,
               awvalid, awready,
               wdata, wstrb, wlast, wvalid, wready,
               bid, bresp, bvalid, bready,
               arid, araddr, arlen, arsize, arburst,
               arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos,
               arvalid, arready,
               rid, rdata, rresp, rlast, rvalid, rready
    );

    // -------- 内部 ID 计数器（自增） --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] awid_cnt;
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] arid_cnt;

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // INIT TASK
    // - 将所有 master 输出信号初始化为默认值
    // ============================================================
    task automatic init();
        cb_master.awid    <= '0;
        cb_master.awaddr  <= '0;
        cb_master.awlen   <= '0;
        cb_master.awsize  <= '0;
        cb_master.awburst <= 2'b01;
        cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
        cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
        cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
        cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.wdata   <= '0;
        cb_master.wstrb   <= '0;
        cb_master.wlast   <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.wvalid  <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.bready  <= 1'b1;
        cb_master.arid    <= '0;
        cb_master.araddr  <= '0;
        cb_master.arlen   <= '0;
        cb_master.arsize  <= '0;
        cb_master.arburst <= 2'b01;
        cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.arcache <= 4'b0000;
        cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
        cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
        cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b0;
        cb_master.rready  <= 1'b0;
        awid_cnt <= '0;
        arid_cnt <= '0;
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - 自动按 MAX_BEATS 拆分成多个 burst
    // - 单DW时 burst=1，等待B后再返回；多DW时流水线模式
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb = 4'b1111
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        bit single_dw;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        if (single_dw) begin
            // ======== 单 DW：AW+W 同拍发送，等 AW 接受后立刻等 W（FIXED） ========
            automatic int lane_off = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
            logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
            logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
            beat_data[lane_off*32 +: 32] = data[0];
            beat_strb[lane_off*4  +: 4]  = strb;

            // 同拍发送 AW + W
            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.awid    <= awid_cnt;
            cb_master.awaddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_off * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.awlen   <= 8'b0;
            cb_master.awsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.awburst <= 2'b00;  // FIXED
            cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
            cb_master.wdata   <= beat_data;
            cb_master.wstrb   <= beat_strb;
            cb_master.wlast   <= 1'b1;
            cb_master.wvalid  <= 1'b1;

            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.awready);
            cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b0;
            awid_cnt <= awid_cnt + 1'b1;

            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);
            cb_master.wlast   <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.wvalid  <= 1'b0;

            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);
            if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, cb_master.bresp, addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE OK: addr=0x%0h data=0x%0h", $time, addr, data[0]);

        end else begin
            // ======== 多 DW：流水线模式（AW/W连续，B统一收集） ========
            int idx = 0;
            int burst_cnt = 0;
            int b_ok_cnt = 0;
            int b_err_cnt = 0;

            while (idx < total_dw) begin
                int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
                int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
                int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
                int beat_cnt;
                int dw_covered;

                if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                    beat_cnt   = 1;
                    dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end else begin
                    int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                    int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                    beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                    dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end

                burst_cnt++;

                // 同拍发送 AW + 第一拍 W 数据
                int dw_ptr = 0;
                logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] first_beat_data = '0;
                logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] first_beat_strb = '0;
                int first_lane_start = lane_offset;
                int first_lanes_this = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;

                {
                    int l;
                    for (l = 0; l < first_lanes_this; l++) begin
                        int lane = first_lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + l;
                        if (gidx < total_dw) begin
                            first_beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                            first_beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = 4'b1111;
                        end
                    end
                    dw_ptr = l;
                }

                @(posedge aclk);
                cb_master.awid    <= awid_cnt;
                cb_master.awaddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
                cb_master.awlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
                cb_master.awsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
                cb_master.awburst <= 2'b01;
                cb_master.awlock  <= 1'b0;
                cb_master.awcache <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.awprot  <= 3'b000;
                cb_master.awqos   <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.awvalid <= 1'b1;
                cb_master.wdata   <= first_beat_data;
                cb_master.wstrb   <= first_beat_strb;
                cb_master.wlast   <= (beat_cnt == 1);
                cb_master.wvalid  <= 1'b1;
                do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.awready);
                awid_cnt <= awid_cnt + 1'b1;

                // 后续 W beats（如果 beat_cnt > 1）
                for (int b = 1; b < beat_cnt; b++) begin
                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = 4'b1111;
                    end

                    cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
                    cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
                    cb_master.wlast  <= (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);
                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
                cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b0;

                // ---- B channel ----
                do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);

                if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00) begin
                    b_err_cnt++;
                    $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.bid, cb_master.bresp);
                end else begin
                    b_ok_cnt++;
                end

                idx      += dw_covered;
                cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
            end

            if (b_err_cnt > 0)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: %0d OK, %0d ERR", $time, b_ok_cnt, b_err_cnt);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ALL DONE: %0d bursts OK", $time, burst_cnt);
        end
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr    : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw: 需要读取的DW个数，默认1
    // - 结果保存在内部成员 rd_data[] 中
    // - 单DW时等待R数据返回；多DW时流水线模式
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw = 1
    );
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        if (total_dw == 1) begin
            // ======== 单 DW：顺序 AR→R（FIXED burst，pulse arvalid） ========
            automatic int lane_off = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;

            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.arid    <= arid_cnt;
            cb_master.araddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_off * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.arlen   <= 8'b0;
            cb_master.arsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.arburst <= 2'b00;  // FIXED
            cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.arcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.arready);
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b0;
            arid_cnt <= arid_cnt + 1'b1;

            cb_master.rready <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.rvalid);
            rd_data[0] = cb_master.rdata[lane_off*32 +: 32];
            if (cb_master.rresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, cb_master.rresp, addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI READ OK: addr=0x%0h data=0x%0h", $time, addr, rd_data[0]);
            cb_master.rready <= 1'b0;

        end else begin
            // ======== 多 DW：流水线模式（AR 连续，R 统一收集） ========
            int idx = 0;
            int burst_cnt;
            int burst_start[256];
            int burst_beats[256];
            int burst_dw[256];
            int burst_lane[256];

            burst_cnt = 0;

            while (idx < total_dw) begin
                int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
                int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
                int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
                int beat_cnt;
                int dw_covered;

                if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                    beat_cnt   = 1;
                    dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end else begin
                    int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                    int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                    beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                    dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end

                burst_start[burst_cnt] = idx;
                burst_beats[burst_cnt] = beat_cnt;
                burst_dw[burst_cnt]    = dw_covered;
                burst_lane[burst_cnt]  = lane_offset;
                burst_cnt++;

                @(posedge aclk);
                cb_master.arid    <= arid_cnt;
                cb_master.araddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
                cb_master.arlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
                cb_master.arsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
                cb_master.arburst <= 2'b01;
                cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;
                cb_master.arcache <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
                cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b1;
                do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.arready);
                arid_cnt <= arid_cnt + 1'b1;

                idx      += dw_covered;
                cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
            end

            cb_master.rready <= 1'b1;
            for (int b = 0; b < burst_cnt; b++) begin
                int base    = burst_start[b];
                int b_beats = burst_beats[b];
                int b_dw    = burst_dw[b];
                int l_off   = burst_lane[b];
                int dw_ptr  = 0;
                int beat    = 0;

                while (beat < b_beats) begin
                    @(posedge aclk);
                    if (cb_master.rvalid) begin
                        int lane_start = (beat == 0) ? l_off : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > b_dw)
                            lanes_this_beat = b_dw - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            rd_data[base + dw_ptr + l] = cb_master.rdata[(lane_start + l)*32 +: 32];
                        end

                        if (cb_master.rresp != 2'b00)
                            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.rid, cb_master.rresp);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                        beat++;
                    end
                end
            end
            cb_master.rready <= 1'b0;

            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ALL DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d", $time, addr, total_dw);
        end
    endtask

endinterface

    // ============================================================
    // mailbox：后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集 B/R 响应
    // ============================================================
    mailbox #(bit [1:0]) b_mbox = new();

    typedef struct {
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data;

    } r_beat_t;
    mailbox #(r_beat_t) r_mbox = new();

    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] awid_ctr;
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] arid_ctr;

    // ============================================================
    // 计算单个 sub-burst 参数
    // ============================================================
    function automatic sub_burst_t calc_sub_burst(
        input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr,
        input int                    idx,
        input int                    dw_remain,
        input int                    max_dw_cap
    );
        int lane_offset, first_beat_dw, beat_cnt, dw_covered;

        lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
        first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;

        if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
            beat_cnt   = 1;
            dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end else begin
            int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
            int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
            beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
            dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end

        if (dw_covered > max_dw_cap) begin
            dw_covered = max_dw_cap;
            if (dw_covered <= first_beat_dw)
                beat_cnt = 1;
            else
                beat_cnt = 1 + (dw_covered - first_beat_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
        end

        calc_sub_burst.addr        = cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES);
        calc_sub_burst.beat_cnt    = beat_cnt;
        calc_sub_burst.dw_covered  = dw_covered;

        calc_sub_burst.idx         = idx;

    task automatic write(

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;

        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);

        fork

            begin
                @(posedge aclk);

                    awid    <= #TP awid_ctr;
                    awid_ctr = awid_ctr + 1'b1;

                    awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
                    awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;

                end

                wlast  <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        join

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 B 响应 ----
        for (int k = 0; k < sub_list.size(); k++) begin
            bit [1:0] resp;
            b_mbox.get(resp);
            if (resp != 2'b00)

        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",

    // ============================================================

    // - addr           : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw       : 需要读取的DW个数，默认1

    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw        = 1,
        input  int               max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AR 背靠背连续发送，valid 全程不掉 ----
        @(posedge aclk);
        for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
            arid    <= #TP arid_ctr;
            arid_ctr = arid_ctr + 1'b1;
            araddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
            arlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;

        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());

endinterface

    // ============================================================

                    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                    int lane_start = (b == 0) ? lane_offset : 0;
                    int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                    if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > dw_covered)
                        lanes_this_beat = dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                    for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                        int lane = lane_start + l;
                        int gidx = idx + dw_ptr + l;
                        beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                        beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = 4'b1111;
                    end

                    cb_master.wdata  <= beat_data;
                    cb_master.wstrb  <= beat_strb;
                    cb_master.wlast  <= (b == beat_cnt - 1);
                    cb_master.wvalid <= 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.wready);
                    dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                end
                cb_master.wlast  <= 1'b0;

                // ---- B channel ----
                do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.bvalid);

                if (cb_master.bresp != 2'b00) begin
                    b_err_cnt++;
                    $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: bid=%0d bresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.bid, cb_master.bresp);
                end else begin
                    b_ok_cnt++;
                end

                idx      += dw_covered;
                cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
            end

            if (b_err_cnt > 0)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: %0d OK, %0d ERR", $time, b_ok_cnt, b_err_cnt);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ALL DONE: %0d bursts OK", $time, burst_cnt);
        end
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr    : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw: 需要读取的DW个数，默认1
    // - 结果保存在内部成员 rd_data[] 中
    // - 单DW时等待R数据返回；多DW时流水线模式
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw = 1
    );
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        if (total_dw == 1) begin
            // ======== 单 DW：顺序 AR→R（FIXED burst，pulse arvalid） ========
            automatic int lane_off = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;

            @(posedge aclk);
            cb_master.arid    <= arid_cnt;
            cb_master.araddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_off * DW_BYTES));
            cb_master.arlen   <= 8'b0;
            cb_master.arsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
            cb_master.arburst <= 2'b00;  // FIXED
            cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;
            cb_master.arcache <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
            cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.arready);
            cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b0;
            arid_cnt <= arid_cnt + 1'b1;

            cb_master.rready <= 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.rvalid);
            rd_data[0] = cb_master.rdata[lane_off*32 +: 32];
            if (cb_master.rresp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, cb_master.rresp, addr);
            else
                $display("[%0t] AXI READ OK: addr=0x%0h data=0x%0h", $time, addr, rd_data[0]);
            cb_master.rready <= 1'b0;

        end else begin
            // ======== 多 DW：流水线模式（AR 连续，R 统一收集） ========
            int idx = 0;
            int burst_cnt;
            int burst_start[256];
            int burst_beats[256];
            int burst_dw[256];
            int burst_lane[256];

            burst_cnt = 0;

            while (idx < total_dw) begin
                int lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
                int dw_remain     = total_dw - idx;
                int first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;
                int beat_cnt;
                int dw_covered;

                if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
                    beat_cnt   = 1;
                    dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end else begin
                    int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
                    int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
                    beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
                    dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
                    if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
                end

                burst_start[burst_cnt] = idx;
                burst_beats[burst_cnt] = beat_cnt;
                burst_dw[burst_cnt]    = dw_covered;
                burst_lane[burst_cnt]  = lane_offset;
                burst_cnt++;

                @(posedge aclk);
                cb_master.arid    <= arid_cnt;
                cb_master.araddr  <= (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES));
                cb_master.arlen   <= (beat_cnt - 1);
                cb_master.arsize  <= AWSIZE_FULL;
                cb_master.arburst <= 2'b01;
                cb_master.arlock  <= 1'b0;
                cb_master.arcache <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.arprot  <= 3'b000;
                cb_master.arqos   <= 4'b0000;
                cb_master.arvalid <= 1'b1;
                do @(posedge aclk); while (!cb_master.arready);
                arid_cnt <= arid_cnt + 1'b1;

                idx      += dw_covered;
                cur_addr  = (cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES)) + beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
            end

            cb_master.rready <= 1'b1;
            for (int b = 0; b < burst_cnt; b++) begin
                int base    = burst_start[b];
                int b_beats = burst_beats[b];
                int b_dw    = burst_dw[b];
                int l_off   = burst_lane[b];
                int dw_ptr  = 0;
                int beat    = 0;

                while (beat < b_beats) begin
                    @(posedge aclk);
                    if (cb_master.rvalid) begin
                        int lane_start = (beat == 0) ? l_off : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > b_dw)
                            lanes_this_beat = b_dw - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            rd_data[base + dw_ptr + l] = cb_master.rdata[(lane_start + l)*32 +: 32];
                        end

                        if (cb_master.rresp != 2'b00)
                            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: rid=%0d rresp=%0d", $time, cb_master.rid, cb_master.rresp);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                        beat++;
                    end
                end
            end
            cb_master.rready <= 1'b0;

            $display("[%0t] AXI READ ALL DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d", $time, addr, total_dw);
        end
    endtask

endinterface

```
// ================================================================
// AXI4 Master Interface
// - AW/W 通过 fork-join 并行独立推进，互不阻塞
// - B/R 响应通过 mailbox + 后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集
// - 自动按 MAX_BEATS / max_burst_bytes 拆分成 sub-burst
// - awid/arid 自增累加，仅用于协议/调试，不用于响应匹配
// - 不支持乱序响应，假设 DUT 按 FIFO 顺序返回
// ================================================================
interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,   // 单次burst最大拍数
    parameter TP         = 0.1    // clk-to-out 延迟
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // mailbox：后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集 B/R 响应
    // ============================================================
    mailbox #(bit [1:0]) b_mbox = new();

    typedef struct {
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data;
        bit [1:0]              resp;
    } r_beat_t;
    mailbox #(r_beat_t) r_mbox = new();

    // -------- awid/arid 自增计数器 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] awid_ctr;
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] arid_ctr;

    initial begin
        awid_ctr = '0;
        arid_ctr = '0;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 B channel（bready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        bready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (bvalid === 1'b1)
                b_mbox.put(bresp);
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 R channel（rready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        rready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (rvalid === 1'b1) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                beat.data = rdata;
                beat.resp = rresp;
                r_mbox.put(beat);
            end
        end
    end

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    // ============================================================
    // sub-burst 参数描述
    // ============================================================
    typedef struct {
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr;
        int                    beat_cnt;
        int                    dw_covered;
        int                    lane_offset;
        int                    idx;
    } sub_burst_t;

    // ============================================================
    // 计算单个 sub-burst 参数
    // ============================================================
    function automatic sub_burst_t calc_sub_burst(
        input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr,
        input int                    idx,
        input int                    dw_remain,
        input int                    max_dw_cap
    );
        int lane_offset, first_beat_dw, beat_cnt, dw_covered;

        lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
        first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;

        if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
            beat_cnt   = 1;
            dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end else begin
            int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
            int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
            beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
            dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end

        if (dw_covered > max_dw_cap) begin
            dw_covered = max_dw_cap;
            if (dw_covered <= first_beat_dw)
                beat_cnt = 1;
            else
                beat_cnt = 1 + (dw_covered - first_beat_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
        end

        calc_sub_burst.addr        = cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES);
        calc_sub_burst.beat_cnt    = beat_cnt;
        calc_sub_burst.dw_covered  = dw_covered;
        calc_sub_burst.lane_offset = lane_offset;
        calc_sub_burst.idx         = idx;
    endfunction

    // ============================================================
    // INIT TASK：初始化输出信号
    // ============================================================
    task automatic init();
        awid    <= #TP '0;
        awaddr  <= #TP '0;
        awlen   <= #TP '0;
        awsize  <= #TP '0;
        awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
        awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
        awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
        awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
        awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
        awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        wdata   <= #TP '0;
        wstrb   <= #TP '0;
        wlast   <= #TP 1'b0;
        wvalid  <= #TP 1'b0;
        bready  <= #TP 1'b1;
        arid    <= #TP '0;
        araddr  <= #TP '0;
        arlen   <= #TP '0;
        arsize  <= #TP '0;
        arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
        arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
        arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
        arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
        arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
        arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        rready  <= #TP 1'b0;
        awid_ctr = '0;
        arid_ctr = '0;
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大写入字节数，默认128
    // - AW/W 通过 fork-join 并行推进，互不阻塞
    // - 所有 B 响应通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb            = 4'b1111,
        input int              max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        bit single_dw;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AW/W 作为两个独立线程并行推进 ----
        fork
            // AW 线程
            begin
                @(posedge aclk);
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    awid    <= #TP awid_ctr;
                    awid_ctr = awid_ctr + 1'b1;
                    awaddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
                    awlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                    awsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
                    awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
                    awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
                    awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
                    awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
                end
                awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
            // W 线程
            begin
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    int dw_ptr = 0;
                    for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                        logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            int gidx = sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l;
                            logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                            beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                            beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                        end

                        wdata  <= #TP beat_data;
                        wstrb  <= #TP beat_strb;
                        wlast  <= #TP (b == sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                        wvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                        do @(posedge aclk); while (!wready);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                    end
                end
                wvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
                wlast  <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        join

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 B 响应 ----
        for (int k = 0; k < sub_list.size(); k++) begin
            bit [1:0] resp;
            b_mbox.get(resp);
            if (resp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: sub-burst#%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, k, resp, addr);
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr           : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw       : 需要读取的DW个数，默认1
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大读取字节数，默认128
    // - AR 背靠背连续发送所有 sub-burst
    // - 所有 R 数据通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw        = 1,
        input  int               max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AR 背靠背连续发送，valid 全程不掉 ----
        @(posedge aclk);
        for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
            arid    <= #TP arid_ctr;
            arid_ctr = arid_ctr + 1'b1;
            araddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
            arlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!arready);
        end
        arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 R 数据并解包 ----
        foreach (sub_list[s]) begin
            int dw_ptr = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                int lane_start, lanes_this_beat;

                r_mbox.get(beat);

                lane_start      = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                    lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                    int lane = lane_start + l;
                    rd_data[sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l] = beat.data[lane*32 +: 32];
                end

                if (beat.resp != 2'b00)
                    $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: sub-burst#%0d beat#%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h",
                               $time, s, b, beat.resp, addr);

                dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
            end
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
    endtask

endinterface

interface axi4_if #(
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 128,
    parameter ID_WIDTH   = 4,
    parameter MAX_BEATS  = 256,   // 单次burst最大拍数
    parameter TP         = 0.1    // clk-to-out 延迟
) (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n
);

    localparam STRB_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH / 8;

    logic aclk;
    logic aresetn;
    assign aclk    = clk;
    assign aresetn = rst_n;

    // -------- 写地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   awid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] awaddr;
    logic [7:0]            awlen;
    logic [2:0]            awsize;
    logic [1:0]            awburst;
    logic                  awlock;
    logic [3:0]            awcache;
    logic [2:0]            awprot;
    logic [3:0]            awqos;
    logic                  awvalid;
    logic                  awready;

    // -------- 写数据通道 --------
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wdata;
    logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] wstrb;
    logic                  wlast;
    logic                  wvalid;
    logic                  wready;

    // -------- 写响应通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   bid;
    logic [1:0]            bresp;
    logic                  bvalid;
    logic                  bready;

    // -------- 读地址通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   arid;
    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] araddr;
    logic [7:0]            arlen;
    logic [2:0]            arsize;
    logic [1:0]            arburst;
    logic                  arlock;
    logic [3:0]            arcache;
    logic [2:0]            arprot;
    logic [3:0]            arqos;
    logic                  arvalid;
    logic                  arready;

    // -------- 读数据通道 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   rid;
    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
    logic [1:0]            rresp;
    logic                  rlast;
    logic                  rvalid;
    logic                  rready;

    localparam DW_BYTES    = 4;
    localparam DW_PER_BEAT = STRB_WIDTH / DW_BYTES;
    localparam AWSIZE_FULL = $clog2(STRB_WIDTH);

    initial begin
        if (MAX_BEATS > 256)
            $fatal(1, "AXI4 interface: MAX_BEATS(%0d) exceeds protocol limit 256", MAX_BEATS);
    end

    // ============================================================
    // mailbox：后台进程按 FIFO 顺序收集 B/R 响应
    // ============================================================
    mailbox #(bit [1:0]) b_mbox = new();

    typedef struct {
        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data;
        bit [1:0]              resp;
    } r_beat_t;
    mailbox #(r_beat_t) r_mbox = new();

    // -------- awid/arid 自增计数器 --------
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] awid_ctr;
    logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0] arid_ctr;

    initial begin
        awid_ctr = '0;
        arid_ctr = '0;
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 B channel（bready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        bready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (bvalid === 1'b1)
                b_mbox.put(bresp);
        end
    end

    // ============================================================
    // 后台进程：常驻监听 R channel（rready 永久保持 1）
    // ============================================================
    initial begin
        rready <= 1'b1;
        forever begin
            @(posedge aclk);
            if (rvalid === 1'b1) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                beat.data = rdata;
                beat.resp = rresp;
                r_mbox.put(beat);
            end
        end
    end

    // -------- read task 结果保存在此，供外部读取 --------
    logic [31:0] rd_data[];

    // ============================================================
    // sub-burst 参数描述
    // ============================================================
    typedef struct {
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr;
        int                    beat_cnt;
        int                    dw_covered;
        int                    lane_offset;
        int                    idx;
    } sub_burst_t;

    // ============================================================
    // 计算单个 sub-burst 参数
    // ============================================================
    function automatic sub_burst_t calc_sub_burst(
        input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr,
        input int                    idx,
        input int                    dw_remain,
        input int                    max_dw_cap
    );
        int lane_offset, first_beat_dw, beat_cnt, dw_covered;

        lane_offset   = (cur_addr % STRB_WIDTH) / DW_BYTES;
        first_beat_dw = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_offset;

        if (dw_remain <= first_beat_dw) begin
            beat_cnt   = 1;
            dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end else begin
            int rest_dw    = dw_remain - first_beat_dw;
            int full_beats = (rest_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (full_beats > MAX_BEATS - 1) full_beats = MAX_BEATS - 1;
            beat_cnt   = 1 + full_beats;
            dw_covered = first_beat_dw + full_beats * DW_PER_BEAT;
            if (dw_covered > dw_remain) dw_covered = dw_remain;
        end

        if (dw_covered > max_dw_cap) begin
            dw_covered = max_dw_cap;
            if (dw_covered <= first_beat_dw)
                beat_cnt = 1;
            else
                beat_cnt = 1 + (dw_covered - first_beat_dw + DW_PER_BEAT - 1) / DW_PER_BEAT;
        end

        calc_sub_burst.addr        = cur_addr - (lane_offset * DW_BYTES);
        calc_sub_burst.beat_cnt    = beat_cnt;
        calc_sub_burst.dw_covered  = dw_covered;
        calc_sub_burst.lane_offset = lane_offset;
        calc_sub_burst.idx         = idx;
    endfunction

    // ============================================================
    // INIT TASK：初始化输出信号
    // ============================================================
    task automatic init();
        awid    <= #TP '0;
        awaddr  <= #TP '0;
        awlen   <= #TP '0;
        awsize  <= #TP '0;
        awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
        awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
        awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
        awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
        awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
        awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        wdata   <= #TP '0;
        wstrb   <= #TP '0;
        wlast   <= #TP 1'b0;
        wvalid  <= #TP 1'b0;
        bready  <= #TP 1'b1;
        arid    <= #TP '0;
        araddr  <= #TP '0;
        arlen   <= #TP '0;
        arsize  <= #TP '0;
        arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
        arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
        arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
        arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
        arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
        arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
        rready  <= #TP 1'b0;
        awid_ctr = '0;
        arid_ctr = '0;
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // WRITE TASK
    // - addr : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - data[]: 32bit数组，每个元素代表一个DW
    // - strb  : 单个4bit值，仅在 data.size()==1 时生效
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大写入字节数，默认128
    // - AW/W 通过 fork-join 并行推进，互不阻塞
    // - 所有 B 响应通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic write(
        input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input [31:0]           data[],
        input [3:0]            strb            = 4'b1111,
        input int              max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int total_dw = data.size();
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        bit single_dw;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI WRITE: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        single_dw = (total_dw == 1);

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AW/W 作为两个独立线程并行推进 ----
        fork
            // AW 线程
            begin
                @(posedge aclk);
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    awid    <= #TP awid_ctr;
                    awid_ctr = awid_ctr + 1'b1;
                    awaddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
                    awlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                    awsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
                    awburst <= #TP 2'b01;
                    awlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
                    awcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
                    awqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
                    awvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                    do @(posedge aclk); while (!awready);
                end
                awvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
            // W 线程
            begin
                for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
                    int dw_ptr = 0;
                    for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                        logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] beat_data = '0;
                        logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] beat_strb = '0;
                        int lane_start = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                        int lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;

                        if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                            lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                        for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                            int lane = lane_start + l;
                            int gidx = sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l;
                            logic [3:0] this_strb = single_dw ? strb : 4'b1111;

                            beat_data[lane*32 +: 32] = data[gidx];
                            beat_strb[lane*4  +: 4]  = this_strb;
                        end

                        wdata  <= #TP beat_data;
                        wstrb  <= #TP beat_strb;
                        wlast  <= #TP (b == sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
                        wvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
                        do @(posedge aclk); while (!wready);

                        dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
                    end
                end
                wvalid <= #TP 1'b0;
                wlast  <= #TP 1'b0;
            end
        join

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 B 响应 ----
        for (int k = 0; k < sub_list.size(); k++) begin
            bit [1:0] resp;
            b_mbox.get(resp);
            if (resp != 2'b00)
                $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE ERROR: sub-burst#%0d bresp=%0d addr=0x%0h", $time, k, resp, addr);
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI WRITE DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
    endtask

    // ============================================================
    // READ TASK
    // - addr           : 起始字节地址，必须4字节(DW)对齐
    // - total_dw       : 需要读取的DW个数，默认1
    // - max_burst_bytes: 单次sub-burst最大读取字节数，默认128
    // - AR 背靠背连续发送所有 sub-burst
    // - 所有 R 数据通过 mailbox 按 FIFO 顺序收集
    // ============================================================
    task automatic read(
        input  [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr,
        input  int               total_dw        = 1,
        input  int               max_burst_bytes = 128
    );
        int idx = 0;
        logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] cur_addr = addr;
        int max_dw_by_bytes;
        sub_burst_t sub_list[$];

        if (addr[1:0] != 2'b00)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: addr 0x%0h is not DW(4-byte) aligned", addr);

        if (max_burst_bytes < DW_BYTES)
            $fatal(1, "AXI READ: max_burst_bytes(%0d) must be at least %0d", max_burst_bytes, DW_BYTES);

        max_dw_by_bytes = max_burst_bytes / DW_BYTES;
        rd_data = new[total_dw];

        // ---- 第一步：纯计算全部 sub-burst 参数 ----
        while (idx < total_dw) begin
            sub_burst_t sb = calc_sub_burst(cur_addr, idx, total_dw - idx, max_dw_by_bytes);
            sub_list.push_back(sb);
            idx      += sb.dw_covered;
            cur_addr  = sb.addr + sb.beat_cnt * STRB_WIDTH;
        end

        // ---- 第二步：AR 背靠背连续发送，valid 全程不掉 ----
        @(posedge aclk);
        for (int s = 0; s < sub_list.size(); s++) begin
            arid    <= #TP arid_ctr;
            arid_ctr = arid_ctr + 1'b1;
            araddr  <= #TP sub_list[s].addr;
            arlen   <= #TP (sub_list[s].beat_cnt - 1);
            arsize  <= #TP AWSIZE_FULL;
            arburst <= #TP 2'b01;
            arlock  <= #TP 1'b0;
            arcache <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arprot  <= #TP 3'b000;
            arqos   <= #TP 4'b0000;
            arvalid <= #TP 1'b1;
            do @(posedge aclk); while (!arready);
        end
        arvalid <= #TP 1'b0;

        // ---- 第三步：按 FIFO 顺序取回全部 R 数据并解包 ----
        foreach (sub_list[s]) begin
            int dw_ptr = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < sub_list[s].beat_cnt; b++) begin
                r_beat_t beat;
                int lane_start, lanes_this_beat;

                r_mbox.get(beat);

                lane_start      = (b == 0) ? sub_list[s].lane_offset : 0;
                lanes_this_beat = DW_PER_BEAT - lane_start;
                if (dw_ptr + lanes_this_beat > sub_list[s].dw_covered)
                    lanes_this_beat = sub_list[s].dw_covered - dw_ptr;

                for (int l = 0; l < lanes_this_beat; l++) begin
                    int lane = lane_start + l;
                    rd_data[sub_list[s].idx + dw_ptr + l] = beat.data[lane*32 +: 32];
                end

                if (beat.resp != 2'b00)
                    $display("[%0t] AXI READ ERROR: sub-burst#%0d beat#%0d rresp=%0d addr=0x%0h",
                               $time, s, b, beat.resp, addr);

                dw_ptr += lanes_this_beat;
            end
        end

        $display("[%0t] AXI READ DONE: addr=0x%0h total_dw=%0d sub_bursts=%0d",
                   $time, addr, total_dw, sub_list.size());
